subject: REAR BRAKE LOCKUP
summary: SUMMARY: THE REAR CYLINDER DIAMETER WAS REDUCED FOR 1984 MODELS TO IMPROVEBRAKING BALANCE FOR EMPTY VEHICLES.GM CLAIMS REAR BRAKES CAN BE LOCKEDON MOST EMPTY PICKUPS ON LOW TRACTION SURFACES.ANALYSIS:PICKUP TRUCKS TRADITIONALLY HAVE BEEN DESIGNED WITH BRAKINGSYSTEMS WHICH CAUSED THE REAR BRAKES TO LOCK FIRST WHEN THE CARGO BED ISEMPTY, SO THAT MAXIMUM EFFECTIVE BRAKING IS AVAILABLE WHEN A LOAD ISPRESENT. MOST MODERN LIGHT TRUCKS AND VANS UTILIZE WEIGHT SENSITIVE PROP-ORTIONING VALVES TO PROVIDE GOOD BRAKING AT ALL LOADS.STATUS:C-MEMO MAY NEED REVISION.IN FINAL BY 12/31/87.===

subject: REAR BRAKE LOCKUP
summary: SUMMARY: THE PROPORTIONING VALVE WAS CHANGED FOR 1983 MODELS (470 PSI TO250 PSI SPLIT POINT) TO REDUCE REAR BRAKE TORQUE. GM CLAIMS THAT BRAKINGPERFORMANCE MAY BE LIMITED BY TIRE TRACTION ON AN UNLOADED VEHICLE WITHNEW UNBURNISHED LININGS, BUT BRAKING BALANCE IMPROVES ONCE THE LININGSHAVE BEEN BURNISHED AS A RESULT OF NORMAL USE.ANALYSIS: TESTING AT ETF SHOWS THAT BRAKING PERFORMANCE OF AN UNLOADEDVEHICLE WAS IMPROVED BY USE OF THE 1983 PROPORTIONING VALVE BUT BRAKINGEFFICIENCY WITH THE 1982 CONFIGURATION APPEARED TO BE ACCEPTABLE (79% TO90% ON LOW FRICTION SURFACES).STATUS: CLOSED 9/4/87.===

subject: REAR BRAKE LOCKUP
summary: SUMMARY: CHEVETTE DIESELS HAVE THE SAME BRAKING SYSTEM AS GASOLINE ENGINEEQUIPPED CHEVETTES BUT CARRY MORE WEIGHT ON THE FRONT WHEELS.ALL 1983MODELS UTILIZE A DIFFERENT PROPORTIONING VALVE AND LARGER FRONT BRAKECALIPER PISTONS TO INCREASE FRONT BRAKE TORQUE.GM CLAIMS REAR BRAKEBIAS IS OF A MAGNITUDE WHICH DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A SAFETY DEFECT.ANALYSIS: TESTING AT ETF SHOWS THE SUBJECT VEHICLES HAVE SUBSTANTIALLYLESS THAN AVERAGE ADHESION UTILIZATION WHEN TESTED IN THE AS RECEIVEDCONDITION BUT THEY PERFORMED WELL WHEN NEW, PROPERLY BURNISHED LININGSWERE INSTALLED.TESTS USING NEW BURNISHED LININGS DID NOT SUPPORT THECONSUMER COMPLAINT DATA OR DESIGN CHANGE THEORY, POSSIBLY DUE TO SMALLSAMPLE SIZE.(TESTING INDICATES THE SUBJECT VEHICLES ARE BETTER THANSOME GM A BODY GROUPS BUT WORSE THAN THE AVERAGE A BODY.GM IR RESPONSE DATED 5/15/87.STATUS:BRIEFING TO BE PREPARED.===

summary: SUMMARY:NATIONAL (FORMERLY DOLPHIN) IS THE LARGEST MICRO-MINI MOTORHOME MANUFACTURER.SINCE 1980 ALL THEIR VEHICLES HAVE BEEN 20 FT OR GREATER, REQUIRING EXTENDED FRAMES AND AFTERMARKET DUAL REAR WHEEL CONVERSIONS.NATIONAL HAS BUILT ON TOYOTA, NISSAN AND CHEVROLET MINI TRUCK CHASSIS.NATIONAL HAS UPGRADED THE GVWR OF THEIR UNITS AFTER CONDUCTING COME FMVSS 105 BRAKE COMPLIANCE TESTS.ANALYSIS:RECEIPT OF FAILURE REPORTS INDICATES THAT NATIONAL'S RELIANCE ON THE BRAKE COMPLIANCE TESTING IS NOT SUFFICIENT AND THAT THE VEHICLES ARE OVERLOADED.STATUS:DEFECT REVIEW PANEL HELD ON 4/27/87. GM DOES NOT BELIEVE THE PROBLEM IS SAFETY RELATEDAND WILL CONDUCT A SERVICE CAMPAIGN.ANALYSIS:THE HIGHEST FAILURE RATES HAVE OCCURRED ON VEHICLES EQUIPPEDWITH AC AND PS WHICH USE A TRIPLE SHEAVE PULLEY. THE MODIFICATION KITSHOULD REDUCE THE FAILURE RATE ON THESE VEHICLES.STATUS: GM LAUNCHED A SERVICE CAMPAIGN IN FEBRUARY 1987 APPLICABLE TO185,000 T BODY VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH TRIPLE PULLEYS. (PRODUCT CAMPAIGN84C27)EA CLOSED 9/4/87===

subject: SEPARATION
summary: SUMMARY:THE ARROWCRAFT DUAL WHEEL CONVERSION CONSISTS OF A SERIES OFSMALL PIPES WELDED TO A LARGE DIAMETER PIPE TO REPRODUCE A THE OEMWHEEL BOLT CIRCLE.THE SECOND WHEEL IS ATTACHED OUTBOARD OF THEFIRST WHEEL.THIS METHOD CAUSES A SEVERE BENDING MOMENT TO BEAPPLIED TO THE INNER WHEEL ATTACHMENT AND THE AXLE BEARINGS.ANALYSIS:THE ARROWCRAFT DUAL WHEEL ADAPTER WAS USED BY THE MICRO-MINI MOTORHOME MANUFACTURERS PRIMARILY BEFORE 1982.THEIR ADAPTERWAS AN ALTERNATIVE TO THE ONE PIECE, DUAL TIRED RIM ASSEMBLY.STATUS: ARROWCRAFT HAS FAILED TO CONDUCT A RECALL AS DESCRIBED BYTHE COMPANY PRESIDENT. subject: POWER BRAKE ASSIST
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER: IN ANALYZING THIS MATTER GMIDENTIFIED THREE PRIMARY SOURCES FOR THE COMPLAINTS.THE FIRST INVOLVESA GRADUAL DETERIORATION IN PERFORMANCE OF BELT DRIVEN VACUUM PUMPS.AC-CORDING TO GM, VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH VACUUM PUMPS ARE ALSO EQUIPPED WITHA LOW VACUUM WARNING LIGHT, WHICH IS ILLUMINATED WHEN BOOSTER VACUUMFALLS BELOW 10 IN. HG.THIS SIGNALS THE DRIVER THAT MAINTENANCE IS NEED-ED.THE SECOND SOURCE OF COMPLAINTS WAS TRACED TO A QUALITY CONTROL PROB-LEM ASSOCIATED WITH ONE OF THE BRAKE BOOSTER DIAPHRAGM SUPPLIERS. USE OFPARTS FROM THIS SUPPLIER WAS DISCONTINUED IN SEPTEMBER 1984.THE THIRDCOMPLAINT SOURCE IDENTIFIED BY GM IS THE LOW VACUUM WARNING LIGHT IN 1982MODELS. ACCORDING TO GM, THE LIGHT INDICATED LOW VACUUM WHEN THERE WAS NOPROBLEM OR A LEAK IN THE SWITCH RESULTED IN REDUCED VACUUM AND ILLUMINA-TION OF THE LIGHT.THIS WAS ALSO TRACED TO A GM SUPPLIER THAT WAS DIS-CONTINUED IN 1982.GM ISSUED FIELD SERVICE INFORMATION COVERING SWITCHREPLACEMENT IN LATE 1982.ANALYSIS: GM HAS IDENTIFIED SPECIFIC VEHICLE COMPONENTS RESPONSIBLE FORREDUCED POWER BRAKE VACUUM ASSIST AMONG THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.THE NUMBERAND NATURE OF THE ODI AND GM COMPLAINTS RECEIVED ALONG WITH THE ALLEGEDACCIDENTS REPORTED INDICATE A POTENTIAL VEHICLE SAFETY PROBLEM.STATUS:THE FINAL REPORT CONCERNING THE OWNER SURVEY FROM THEAUTOMOBILE CLUB OF SOUTHERN CALIFORNIA WAS RECEIVED ON 6/10/87.===

subject: SEATBACK FAILURE
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:FORD BELIEVES THAT THE AL-LEGED DEFECT ONLY OCCURS IN A SMALL NUMBER OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES ANDRECALLED ABOUT 195,732 1984 TEMPO/TOPAZ VEHICLES IN JUNE 1986.ANALYSIS: VEHICLES POTENTIALLY INVOLVED INCLUDE TEMPO/TOPAZ, ESCORT/LYNX/EXP, MUSTANG/CAPRI, LTD/MARQUIS, AND THUNDERBIRD/COUGAR.FORD SOLD ABOUT 110,000 REPLACEMENT MIO BOLTS, MAINLY FOR 1983 AND 1984MODELS. LOW CLAMPING FORCE APPEARS TO BE A LARGE PART OF THE PROBLEM.FORD INCREASED THE TORQUE REQUIREMENTS AND REQUIRED THE USE OF A MANUALTORQUE TOOL IN MARCH AND SEPTEMBER 1985 PRODUCTION CHANGES. 1987 MODELSWILL BE PRODUCED WITH A LONGER M10 BOLT AND A NUT TO INCREASE AND MAIN-TAIN CLAMPING FORCE. BOLTS WERE FORMERLY SELF TAPPING. REPORTS LISTEDABOVE SPECIFICALLY STATE THAT THE BOLT BROKE. NONE REFER SIMPLY TOSEAT BACK COLLAPSE ALONE.STATUS:FORD REPLY TO ODI IR DATED 2/2/87.FORD RECALLED 195,7321984 TEMPO/TOPAZ VEHICLES IN JUNE 1986 (86V-082). ANALYZING REPONSE,MONITORING CANADIAN PROGRESS. RESPONSE TO 4/6/87 LETTER TO FORDRECEIVED 7/15/87. WILL PROBABLY CLOSE AFTER CANADA COMPLETES THEIRACTIONS.===

subject: SUDDEN ACCELERATION
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:MANUFACTURER PROVIDED FAILUREDATA REGARDING THE EXTENT AND NATURE OF THE ALLEGED DEFECT.NO RELEVANTSERVICE BULLETINS HAVE BEEN ISSUED NOR SERVICE CAMPAIGNS UNDERTAKEN WHICHRELATE TO THE ALLEGED PROBLEM.NO TRENDS WERE FOUND WHICH RELATE TO DATEOR PLANT OF VEHICLE MANUFACTURE, GEOGRAPHIC LOCATION, OR DATE OF THEALLEGED INCIDENT.INFORMATION WAS PROVIDED TO DOCUMENT MAXIMUM ENGINESPEEDS AS A RESULT OF MALFUNCTION OF VARIOUS COMPONENTS, AND COMBINATIONSOF COMPONENTS, IN THE FUEL SUPPLY, EMISSIONS CONTROL, IGNITION CONTROL,AND ENGINE IDLE SPEED CONTROL SYSTEMS, WITH THE TRANSMISSION IN PARK, ANDWHEN SHIFTED INTO DRIVE OR REVERSE.DATA WERE ALSO PROVIDED REGARDINGENGINE NOISE LEVELS AT HIGHER THAN NORMAL IDLE SPEEDS.ANALYSIS:NO SPECIFIC MODE OF COMPONENT OR SYSTEM FAILURE OR MALFUNCTIONWAS IDENTIFIED AS CAUSAL TO THE ALLEGED INCIDENTS.THE MANUFACTURER'SATTEMPTS TO REPLICATE EACH OF THE ALLEGED INCIDENTS WERE UNSUCCESSFUL, ANDNO PHYSICAL MALFUNCTIONS WERE DISCOVERED IN ANY OF THE VEHICLES INSPECTED.MALFUNCTIONS OF COMPONENTS AND SUBSYSTEMS WHICH MIGHT AFFECT ENGINE SPEEDWERE FOUND TO RESULT IN SLIGHTLY HIGHER THAN NORMAL ENGINE SPEEDS WHILE INPARK, BUT THESE CONSISTENTLY RETURNED TO NORMAL WHEN THE TRANSMISSIONWAS SHIFTED INTO FORWARD OR REVERSE GEAR.NO SYSTEMATIC MECHANICAL ORELECTRICAL FAILURE INHERENT TO THE DESIGN OR MANUFACTURE OF THE VEHICLEWAS IDENTIFIED AS CAUSAL TO A SELF-ACTUATING, SUSTAINED INCREASE IN ENGINESPEED THAT WOULD RESULT IN UNINTENDED VEHICLE ACCELERATION.===

subject: PLATE HANGS UP
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:ANCHORLOK'S INVESTIGATION DOESNOT SHOW THAT THIS PRODUCT IS DEFECTIVE IN ANY SENSE.FIRST, ANY HANG UPIF IT OCCURS AT ALL, IS VERY INFREQUENT.SECOND, EVEN IF IT OCCURS, DUE TOTHE SELF-HEALING EFFECT BROUGHT ABOUT BY THE CHIPPING AWAY OF THE CONERECEPTACLE AND/OR THE TIPPING OF THE PRESSURE PLATE, IT HAS ONLY A MINIMALEFFECT ON LOSS OF STROKE.MOREOVER, WE HAVE NOT FOUND THAT THE HANG UPHAS A DETRIMENTAL EFFECT ON VEHICLE BRAKING PERFORMANCE, WHETHER IN APARKED, EMERGENCY OR DECELERATING CONDITION....ANALYSIS:DATA INDICATES THAT THE ALLEGED PROBLEM MAY BE CAUSED BY ANIMPROPERLY FORMED COMPRESSION SPRING WHICH ALLOWS THE MALE PORTION OF THEPRESSURE PLATE TO CONTACT THE TOP PERIPHERAL OF THE FEMALE CONE, POSSIBLYRESTRICTING THE FULL FUNCTION OF THE SLACK ADJUSTER AND PUSHROD.STATUS:ANALYZING ROCKWELL RESPONSE OF 11/6/87 AND GM RESPONSE OF9/3/87.AWAITING ETF TEST RESULTS REQUESTED BY ODI MEMO DATED 4/22/87.RYDER SYTEMS REPORTS AN AUTOMOTIVE CAR TRAILER SUSTAINED A HUNG UP CHAMBERON 29 SEPTEMBER 87, RESULTING IN THE TRAILER AND EIGHT CADILLAC ALLANTESBEING DESTROYED BY FIRE.AS A RESULT OF THIS DEVELOPMENT, RYDER SYSTEMS ISCONDUCTING AN INVESTIGATION INTO THE HANG UP PHENOMENA.AN IR IS BEINGSENT.===

subject: STEERING CONTROL
summary: ANALYSIS:CLASSIC TIFFANY VEHICLES ARE GREATLY MODIFIED OR ALTERED FORDCOUGAR VEHICLES AND REPRESENT AN EXTREMELY LOW PRODUCTION VOLUME.IN THEAREA OF CONCERN IN THIS ENGINEERING ANALYSIS, THE MODIFICATION CONSISTS OFWELDING A LENGTHENED STEEL UNDERCARRIAGE TO THE FRONT OF THE BODY ANDCHASSIS TO EXTEND THE WHEELBASE BY 38 INCHES.THE SUBJECT VEHICLES HAVETHE STEERING EXTENDED BY MEANS OF AN INTERMEDIATE SHAFT SUPPORTED BY TWOPILLOW BLOCKS AND JOINED TO THE ORIGINAL STEERING SHAFT BY A UNIVERSALJOINT.CLASSIC'S RESPONSE TO THE SPECIAL ORDER DISCLOSED THAT A CONSULTING ENGIN-EER HAD BEEN ENGAGED TO ANALYZE THE STEERING SYSTEM PROBLEMS AND SUGGESTCORRECTIONS.HIS TEST REPORT DISCLOSED THAT THE CYCLIC STEERING WHEELTORQUE VARIATIONS WERE ENTIRELY DUE TO IMPROPERLY PHASED AND SUPPORTEDUNIVERSAL JOINT.THE ENGINEER REPORTED THAT THE STEERING EFFORTFLUCTUATIONS VARIED BETWEEN 200% AND 300%, MAXIMUM TO MINIMUM RATIO WITHPEAKS AND VALLEYS BEING DISPOSED 90 DEGREES.HE CONCLUDED THAT THE SOLECAUSE OF THE FLUCTUATIONS WAS THE RANDOM INSTALLATION OF FOUR UNIVERSALJOINTS COMPOUNDED BY SUPPORT BEARINGS INSTALLED ON SHAFTING THAT SHOULD NOTHAVE BEEN RESTRAINED.HE RECOMMENDED THE USE OF A FLEXIBLE STEERING SHAFTINSTEAD OF THE UNIVERSAL JOINTS TO ACHIEVE A UNIFORM STEERING TORQUETHROUGHOUT 360 DEGREES OF ROTATION.HIS REPORT SHOWED THAT HE HAD INTRODUCED SEVERE, COMBINED TORSIONAL ANDBENDING LOADS ON THE VEHICLE CHASSIS AND FOUND THAT THERE WAS NO MEASURE-ABLE CHANGE IN THE CYCLIC TORSIONAL EFFORT VARIATION.IN ADDITION TO THE RECOMMENDED USE OF A FLEXIBLE STEERING SHAFT, THEENGINEER RECOMMENDED THE INCORPORATION OF A MANIFOLD HEAT SHIELD TOMINIMIZE THE AMOUNT OF HEAT RADIATED INTO THE STEERING COMPONENTS.HEALSO RECOMMENDED INSTITUTION OF AN ACCELERATED DURABILITY TEST OF THESYSTEM.THE ENGINEER'S FINDING SATISFIES ODI'S CONCERN THAT TORSIONAL AND BENDINGLOADS MIGHT ADVERSELY AFFECT VEHICLE STEERING.STATUS:THIS ENGINEERING ANALYSIS WAS CLOSED ON MAY 20, 1987.===

subject: FUEL SPURTING
summary: ANALYSIS OF THE MANUFACTURER INFORMATION:IT APPEARS THAT THE PROBLEM OCCURS ON THE WINNEBAGO MOTORHOMES EQUIPPED WITH AN AUXILIARY FUEL TANK AND HIGH UNDERCARRIAGE TEMPERATURES.ANALYSIS:FUEL RESERVOIR OVERPRESSURE RESULTS WHEN THE MOTORHOMES EQUIPPED WITH AUXILIARY FUEL TANKS ARE EXPOSED TO HIGH UNDERCARRIAGE TEMPERATURES WITHOUT A MODIFIED FUEL CAP AND EVAPORATIVE EMISSION CARBON CANISTER.THE EXISTING COMPONENTS MAY NOT REDUCE THE FUEL PRESSURIZATION THAT CAN RAPIDLY BUILDUP FROM THE LARGE SURFACE AREA OF THE PRIMARY FUEL TANK.OPERATING THE VEHICLE FROM THE AUXILIARY FUEL TANK WITH THE PRIMARY TANK FULL COMPOUNDS THE PROBLEM.HIGH UNDERCARRIAGE TEMPERATURES INCREASE THE FUEL VAPORIZATION.STATUS:WINNEBAGO HAS RECALLED THE SUSPECT VEHICLES TO ALLOW VENTING THEOVER PRESSURE (87V-155).CLOSED 1/6/88. #===

subject: FUEL EXPULSION
summary: SYNOPSIS: UNDER CERTAIN OPERATING CONDITIONS, FUEL IS EXPELLED FROM THEFUEL FILLER PIPE, WHEN THE FILLER CAP IS REMOVED. subject: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES
summary: ANALYSIS:A REVIEW OF FORD MOTOR COMPANY'S RESPONSES TO ODI INFORMATIONREQUESTS ISSUED UNDER PRELIMINARY EVALUATIONS PE 87-012, PE 87-017, ANDPE 87-020, INDICATED THAT THE FAILURE AND/OR MALFUNCTION OF THE SPRING-LOCKFUEL LINE COUPLINGS APPEARED TO BE THE MAJOR SOURCE OR CAUSE OF ENGINECOMPARTMENT FIRES IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.BASED UPON THIS, AN ENGINEERINGANALYSIS WAS INITIATED WHICH INCORPORATED ALL THREE OF THE ABOVE REFERENCEDPRELIMINARY EVALUATIONS.ADDITIONAL REPORTS WERE RECEIVED WHICH INDICATEDTHAT SPRING LOCK FUEL-LINE COUPLING SEPARATION HAD BEEN RESPONSIBLE FORENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES IN OTHER FORD VEHICLES.THE EA WAS THEN EXPANDEDON AUGUST 18TH TO INCLUDE ALL FORD VEHICLES WHICH USE OR DID USE SPRINGLOCK COUPLINGS IN THE FUEL DELIVERY AND/OR THE FUEL RETURN SYSTEM.STATUS:BY LETTER DATED SEPTEMBER 1, 1987, FORD AGREED TO RECALL 3,600,0001986 THROUGH 1988 PASSENGER CARS AND LIGHT TRUCKS EQUIPPED WITH ELECTRONICFUEL-INJECTION (EFI) AND CENTRAL FUEL-INJECTION (CFI) ENGINES THAT WEREPRODUCED WITH A SPECIFIC TYPEOF SPRING LOCK FUEL-LINE COUPLING.IF THESPRING LOCK FUEL-LINE COUPLING WERE IMPROPERLY ENGAGED OR DAMAGED DURINGASSEMBLY OR SERVICING, THEN FUEL PRESSURE, VIBRATION, OR ENGINE MOVEMENTCOULD RESULT IN FUEL LINE SEPARATION AND THE SUBSEQUENT RISK OF A VEHICLEFIRE.TO PREVENT THIS POTENTIAL SEPARATION, THE RECALLED VEHICLES WILLHAVE RETAINER CLIPS INSTALLED OVER THE SPRING LOCK COUPLINGS.THE RECALLNUMBER IS 87V-139.PROPOSED ACTION:BASED UPON THE NATURE AND SCOPE OF THE RECALL, EA 87-020SHOULD BE CLOSED AND THE RECALL'S EFFECTIVENESS MONITORED.===

subject: ENGINE SURGE
summary: THE MANUFACTURER WAS INITIALLY CONTACTED UNDER DP87-003, SUDDEN ACCELER-ATION OF 1983-86 FORD, MERCURY, AND LINCOLN CARS EQUIPPED WITH 3.8 AND 5.0LITER ENGINES AND AUTOMATIC TRANSMISSIONS.ALL INFORMATION SUBMITTED BYTHE MANUFACTURER DEALING WITH SURGING HAS BEEN TRANSFERRED TO THE SUBJECTINVESTIGATIVE FILE.STATUS:ANALYSIS IS CONTINUING TO DETERMINE IF THERE IS AN IDENTIFIABLEDEFECT TREND INVOLVING THE ENTIRE POPULATION OF VEHICLES, OR ANY OF THESPECIFIC 38 COMBINATIONS OF MODEL AND MODEL YEAR WITHIN THE POPULATION.BACKGROUND:UPON COMPLETION OF THE ANALYSIS OF DP87-003, THE PETITION WAS GRANTED FORFURTHER REVIEW OF ENGINE SURGING.IN THE PETITION ANALYSIS, A DISTINCTIONWAS MADE BETWEEN SUDDEN ACCELERATION ACCOMPANIED BY INEFFECTIVE BRAKES, ASOPPOSED TO SURGING WHICH MAY OCCUR IN SITUATIONS THAT ALLOW INSUFFICIENTTIME AND SPACE TO AVOID COLLISION WHEN EXPERIENCED IN CLOSE QUARTERS.THEINFORMATION ACQUIRED INDICATED THAT ALLEGATIONS OF WIDE-OPEN THROTTLESUDDEN ACCELERATION WHICH RENDERED THE SERVICE BRAKES INEFFECTIVE WAS NOTAN ISSUE REQUIRING FURTHER INVESTIGATIVE ACTION.HOWEVER, THE DETAILS OFTHE MAJORITY OF CONSUMER COMPLAINTS INDICATED THAT ENGINE SURGING ASDESCRIBED ABOVE, PRESENTED QUESTIONS REQUIRING ADDITIONAL INVESTIGATIVEREVIEW.ON THIS BASIS, THE SUBJECT EA WAS INITIATED.ANALYSIS OF THE CONSUMER COMPLAINTS ACCUMULATED UNDER DP87-003 DISCLOSEDTHAT THE ABOVE TABULATIONS OF COMPLAINTS, ACCIDENTS, AND INJURIES FALLWITHIN THE DEFINITION OF ENGINE SURGING AS DEFINED IN THE PRECEDINGPARAGRAPH.===

subject: SEAT TRACKS
summary: SUMMARY: A FRACTURED FRONT SEAT TRACK RECEIVED FROM AN ESCORT OWNER SHOWSTHAT METAL FATIGUE OCCURRED WHICH COULD CAUSE PARTIAL MOVEMENT OF THE SEAT.ANOTHER OWNER SENT PICTURES SHOWING FRACTURE AT THE SAME LOCATION. TENOF THE EIGHTEEN ODI COMPLAINTS HAVE BEEN RECEIVED IN THE PAST FOUR MONTHS.MANUFACTURER INFORMATION: FORD MADE TWO SIGNIFICANT MODIFICATIONS TO THESEAT TRACK; ONE INCORPORATED A DOUBLE LATCH SYSTEM, LOCKING BOTH THE IN-BOARD AND OUTBOARD TRACK ASSEMBLIES, AND THE OTHER ADDED WEB DEPTH IN THEFRONT AND REAR OF THE SEAT TRACK.FORD PROVIDED A TOTAL OF 1,741 WARRANTY CLAIMS CONCERNING SEAT TRACKFAILURE ON THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.THEY BELIEVE THAT FRACTURE OF THE SEAT TRACK CAUSES A LIMITED ROCKINGMOTION AND IS NOT A SAFETY PROBLEM.PROPOSED ACTION: IR TO FORD SENT 10/9/87.TEST REQUEST SENT TO ETF10/21/87.

subject: DRAWBAR
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:THE MANUFACTURER STATES THATTHE TRAILERS AND DRAWBARS WERE BUILT TO A CUSTOMER'S SPECIFICATION.ALLEGEDLY A SERIOUS ACCIDENT OCCURRED DUE TO A DRAWBAR BREAKING.DELTACONTACTED THE ODI STAFF TO CLARIFY WHO HAS THE LEGAL RESPONSIBILITY TOCORRECT THE PROBLEM.ANALYSIS:DURING CERTAIN JACK KNIFE TURNS IN CLOSE QUARTERS MANEUVERS,THE DRAW BAR MAY HIT A REINFORCING WING PLATE ON THE PINTLE HOOK STRUCTURE,WHICH CAUSES THE DRAW BAR TO BEND RESULTING IN THE REAR TRAILER NOTTRACKING TRUE.IN SOME INSTANCES THE DRAWBAR BECOMES KINKED, SETTING UPCONDITIONS FOR A CRACK TO GENERATE.DELTA FOUND THAT WHEN THE REINFORCINGPLATES WERE REMOVED, DAMAGE TO THE DRAWBARS CEASED.DELTA REMOVED THETRAILERS FROM SERVICE ON APPROXIMATELY JUNE 5, 1987, AND BEGAN MAKING THENECESSARY REPAIRS.IT APPEARS THAT DELTA IS REPAIRING THE DRAWBARS TOPREVENT INCURRING ANY FUTURE LIABILITY AS THE RESULT OF A DRAWBAR FAILURE.A RECALL REQUEST TO LEGITIMIZE DELTA'S CORRECTIVE ACTION WAS SENT ONJULY 30, 1987.DELTA HAS NOT RESPONDED TO THE LETTER, NOR HAVE THEYRESPONDED TO TELEPHONE MESSAGES.STATUS:DELTA CLAIMS TO HAVE RESPONDED TO OUR RR LETTER ON DECEMBER 8,1987, DELTA WAS CONTACTED AND THEY AGREED FURNISH A DUPLICATE COPY OF THEPREVIOUS RESPONSE.IT HAS YET TO APPEAR.===

subject: STEERING OUTPUT SHAFT
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:BOTH CHRYSLER AND MITSUBISHIINDEPENDENTLY CONCLUDED THAT THE FAILURES WERE DUE TO SEVERE IMPACT LOADINGTRANSMITTED TO THE SHAFT BY THE STEERING LINKAGE SYSTEM -- IN OTHER WORDSSHAFT FAILURE IS THE RESULT, NOT THE CAUSE, OF THE ALLEGED COLLISIONCIRCUMSTANCES.MITSUBISHI (VEHICLE PRODUCER) DID STRENGTHEN THE SHAFTDURING THE 1984 MODEL YEAR BY INCREASING THE SPLINE AND BEARING JOURNALDIAMETERS.ANALYSIS:FAILING COMPONENT IS THE STEERING BOX CROSS SHAFT (OUTPUT SHAFT)WHICH BREAKS BETWEEN THE BOTTOM BEARING IN THE STEERING BOX AND THE PITMANARM.KNOWN FAILURES INVOLVE 4 WHEEL DRIVE UNITS WHICH ARE EQUIPPED WITHPOWER STEERING.CROSS SHAFT AND PITMAN ARM SALES ARE CONSIDERABLY HIGHERON THE 4 WD UNITS THAN THE 2 WD UNITS.CHRYSLER REPORTS THE CROSS SHAFTDIAMETER WAS INCREASED IN APRIL, 1984, FOR INCREASED SHAFT STRENGTH TOIMPROVE ITS CAPABILITY TO WITHSTAND SEVERE IMPACT LOADS.PROPOSED ACTION:IR'S TO CHRYSLER AND MITSUBISHI SENT 11/16 - 17/87.AWAITING RESPONSES.===

subject: SEAT ATTACHMENT
summary: MANUFACTURER INFORMATION: CHRYSLER HAS ISSUED ONE SERVICE BULLETIN, HON-ORED 4,028 WARRANTY CLAIMS, SOLD 2,700 SEATS, AND 2,491 ADJUSTMENT REIN-FORCEMENTS. THE SUBJECT DEFECT APPEARS TO BE SIMILAR TO THE GM J-BODY RE-CALL (87V-079) OF MAY 1987 IN WHICH 1,136,407 VEHICLES WERE RECALLED. INTHAT RECALL THERE WERE 159 COMPLAINTS, 17 ALLEGED ACCIDENTS, AND 26 RE-PORTED INJURIES FOR ABOUT SIX TIMES AS MANY CARS. CHRYSLER HAS PROPOSEDA SERVICE RECALL FOR THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.THEY BELIEVE THAT SINCE INI-TIALLY ONLY ONE OF THE FOUR BOLTS BREAK, AT THAT TIME THE SEAT ROCKINGMOTION IS NOT A SAFETY PROBLEM IF PROMPTLY REPAIRED. THE SUBJECT VEHICLESARE LIMITED TO THOSE EQUIPPED WITH AN ELECTRICAL SEAT ADJUSTMENT SYSTEM.PROPOSED ACTION: TEST REQUEST SENT TO ETF 11/23/87.INSPECTION & TESTINGOF A FEW VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH THE DEFECTIVE SEATS IS ONGOING.===

subject: ENGINE COMPARTMENT FIRES
summary: ANALYSIS:MANY OF THE REPORTS INDICATE THAT THE PLASTIC VALVE COVER OR THE\TV GASKETING MATERIAL LOSES ITS STRUCTURAL AND/OR SEALING INTEGRITY DUE TOTHE HIGH ENGINE TEMPERATURES ASSOCIATED WITH THE AMC 258 ENGINE.TESTINGPERFORMED BY A LOCAL FLEET CLEARLY DEMONSTRATED THAT UNDER NORMAL DRIVINGCONDITIONS, MOTOR OIL LEAKS IN THE VICINITY OF THE #3 OR #4 CYLINDERS (OVERTHE EXHAUST MANIFOLD) CAN RESULT IN A FIRE SERIOUS ENOUGH TO DESTROY AVEHICLE.AMC HAS ISSUED NUMEROUS TSB'S REGARDING THE PROPER/IMPROPER METHOD OF SEAL-ING THE VALVE COVER-HEAD INTERFACE.1981-84 AMC 6-CYLINDER ENGINES AREEQUIPPED WITH A PLASTIC VALVE COVER WHICH HAS 5 GUIDE PINS AND 2 FASTENERS.THE COVER USED IN LATER MODELS WAS RE-DESIGNED TO HAVE 5 ATTACHING POINTS,AND THIS NEW VALVE COVER CAN BE USED ON OLDER ENGINES BY MEANS OF AMODIFICATION KIT.AS EXPECTED, COMPLAINTS OF ENGINE FIRES IN 1985 MODELSDROPPED SIGNIFICANTLY, INDICATING THAT THE ADDITION OF THE NEW VALVE COVERMAY HAVE SOLVED THE PROBLEM.STATUS: IR TO THE MANUFACTURER SENT 12/1/87.PROPOSED ACTION: OPEN AN ENGINEERING ANALYSIS.===

subject: THROTTLE CONTROL
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:UNDER PE87-041, GM PROVIDED THECOMPLAINT, ACCIDENT, INJURY, AND FATALITY DATA TABULATED ABOVE.ANALYSIS:DURING GM'S COMPILATION AND EVALUATION OF INFORMATION REQUIREDTO RESPOND TO THE NHTSA'S REQUEST UNDER THE PE, INDICATIONS WERE GIVEN THATTHE NUMBERS OF CONSUMER AND OTHER COMPLAINTS CLEARLY SUGGESTED THE EXIST-OF A SAFETY PROBLEM AND THAT CORRECTIVE ACTIONS WERE IN ORDER.GM'S FORMALLETTER RESPONSE, HOWEVER, RETREATED FROM THIS POSITION.NHTSA'S ANALYSIS OF THE AVAILABLE INFORMATION IS ONGOING IN AN EFFORT TOIDENTIFY ONE OR MORE PRIMARY MODES OF COMPONENT FAILURE OR MALFUNCTION THATCOULD RESULT IN ANY ONE OR COMBINATION OF THE FOLLOWING:A.SUDDEN ACCELERATION WITH OR WITHOUT ATTENDANT BRAKE FAILUREB.SELF-ACTUATION OF THE CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEMC.FAILURE OF THE CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM TO DEACTIVATE UPON DRIVERCOMMANDD.FAILURE OF THE THROTTLE LINKAGES/MECHANISMS TO RESPOND INMAGNITUDE AND DIRECTION TO DRIVER COMMANDE.ANY OTHER POSSIBLE MALFUNCTION THAT MAY BE IDENTIFIED.THE NUMBERS OF COMPLAINTS AND FIELD REPORTS, TOGETHER WITH RESULTANTACCIDENTS AND INJURIES, ARE SUFFICIENTLY HIGH TO SUGGEST THAT A RIGOROUSEVALUATION OF THIS MATTER BY THE NHTSA IS IN ORDER.STATUS:NO SPECIFIC MALFUNCTION OF THE THROTTLE CONTROL SYSTEM CAPABLEOF CAUSING INCIDENTS OF UNINTENDED SUDDEN ACCELERATION HAS BEEN IDENTIFIEDTO DATE.HOWEVER, INVESTIGATION DISCLOSED THREE CONDITIONS THAT COULDRESTRICT FREE MOVEMENT OF THE THROTTLE CABLE.H-BODY CARS POTENTIALLYAFFECTED BY THIS CONDITION HAVE BEEN RECALLED FOR CORRECTION.OTHERPHASES OF THE INVESTIGATION ARE CONTINUING.PHASES OF THE INVESTIGATION ARE CONTINUING.===

summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:THE SUSPECT UNITS ARE EQUIPPED WITH NON-GM FUEL TANKS WITH SIDE ENTRY RATHER THAN TOP OR CORNER ENTRY. subject: SHUTOFF SOLENOID
summary: SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:THE EFFECT OF THIS FAILURE ONTHE USER IS THAT OF A SIGNIFICANT NUISANCE.IF AN ENGINE SHUTS DOWN,NEITHER THE CONTROLLABILITY OF THE MOVING VEHICLE NOR THE CAPABILITY TOBRING IT TO A STOP IS MATERIALLY AFFECTED AND CATERPILLAR DOES NOT FEELTHAT AN ENGINE SHUTDOWN IS SAFETY RELATED.ANALYSIS:WARRANTY DATA OBTAINED DURING THE PE INDICATES CATERPILLARHAS HAD SIGNIFICANT FAILURES OF FUEL SHUTDOWN SOLENOIDS ON THE SUBJECTENGINES SINCE 1982.ADDITIONALLY, SINCE 1984 5 MECHANICAL AND 5 ELECTRICALCHANGES HAVE BEEN INCORPORATED TO IMPROVE RELIABILITY.AN ENGINE SHUTDOWNWITHOUT WARNING COULD CAUSE THE TRUCK TO BE DIFFICULT TO STEER, AND INCERTAIN SCENARIOS ALLOW THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM TO EXHAUST ITSELF.PROPOSED ACTION:SEND AN IR.===

subject: AXLE NUTS
summary: ANALYSIS:INTERNAL FRUEHAUF MEMORANDUMS SHOW A LONG TERM PROBLEM HASEXISTED WITH THE AXLE NUT FASTENING SYSTEM ON MULTI-AXLE VEHICLES.A HEAVYDUTY NUT WAS MADE AVAILABLE IN LATE 1976 FOR SEVERE USE APPLICATION AND2 YEARS LATER WAS INSTALLED ROUTINELY DURING TRAILER PRODUCTION.PROBLEMSCONTINUED, RESULTING IN THE AVAILABILITY OF A HEAVY DUTY DOUBLE AXLE NUT IN1981, AND ITS ROUTINE INSTALLATION ON SEVERE SERVICE VEHICLES IN 1983.ADDITIONALLY, FRUEHAUF INTERNAL DOCUMENTS INDICATE THAT SOME AXLES AND AXLENUTS HAD AN OUT OF TOLERANCE PROBLEM WHICH INCREASED THE LIKELIHOOD OFTHREADS STRIPPING AND WHEEL SEPARATION.SUMMARY OF INFORMATION FROM MANUFACTURER:A LONG TERM PROBLEM EXISTED WITHVARIOUS CORRECTIVE MEASURES BEING IMPLEMENTED APPARENTLY UNSUCCESSFULLY,UNTIL THE AVAILABILITY OF THE DOUBLE NUT KIT IN 1983.FRUEHAUF'S POSITIONIS THAT AN AXLE NUT PROBLEM DOES NOT EXIST (DUE TO A LACK OF WARRANTYCLAIMS) AND THEREFORE THERE IS NO THREAT TO PUBLIC SAFETY.STATUS:IR BEINGDRAFTED.===

subject: STEERING LOCKUP
summary: SUMMARY:THE PE REVEALED THAT THE STEERING SYSTEM ON THE SUBJECT VEHICLESCONSISTS OF TWO RIGHT ANGLE GEAR BOXES WHICH ARE CONNECTED TO THE TWOSTEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLIES IN THE CAB.THE OUTPUT FROM THESE GEAR BOXES ISCONNECTED, VIA U JOINT FITTED CROSS SHAFTS, TO A THREE WAY RIGHT ANGLE GEARBOX WHICH RECEIVES INPUT FROM EITHER STEERING WHEEL AND OPERATES THESTEERING BOX ON THE CHASSIS.ANALYSIS BY THE CHASSIS MANUFACTURER (GM)INDICATES PROBABLE CAUSE OF HARD STEERING AND COMPONENT FAILURE ISEXCESSIVE SIDE THRUST LOADS IN THE CHASSIS GEAR BOX.PROBABLE CAUSE ISMISALIGNMENT BETWEEN THE THREE WAY GEAR BOX AND THE CHASSIS GEAR BOX.ELGIN HAS MODIFIED AT LEAST 12 UNITS IN THE FIELD WITH A DUAL U JOINTARRANGEMENT WHICH REDUCES THE NEED FOR A PERFECT SHAFT ALIGNMENT BETWEENTHE BOXES.ALTHOUGH NO ACCIDENTS HAVE OCCURRED, THE HIGH FAILURE RATEINDICATES FURTHER ANALYSIS IS NEEDED TO DETERMINE IF MODIFICATION OF THEREMAINING UNITS IS NECESSARY.===

subject: SEAT BACK FAILURE
summary: SUMMARY:SCHOOL DISTRICT REPORTS EXTENDED SEAT BACKS ARE BREAKING AWAYFROM THE SEATS SOLID FRAME.SEAT BACK SEPARATION COULD HAVE A DETRIMENTALEFFECT ON THE VEHICLES COMPARTMENTALIZATION PRINCIPLE IN THE EVENT OF ASERIOUS ACCIDENT.COMPARTMENTALIZATION, AS OUTLINED IN THE STANDARD, REQUIRES STRENGTH INTHE ENTIRE SEATING SYSTEM WHICH INCLUDES THE FLOOR, THE SEAT FRAME AND THEFASTENING OF THE FRAMES TO THE FLOOR WHILE AT THE SAME TIME PROVIDING SEATSYSTEM PADDING AND FLEXIBILITY TO ABSORB ENERGY IN A CRASH.CROWN CLAIMS THE FAILURES RESULT FROM ABUSE AND ARE ISOLATED.A RECENTTELEPHONE CONVERSATION WITH THE FLEET INVOLVED INDICATED THAT 43 ADDITIONALSEATS WERE RECENTLY REMOVED (BY CROWN) FOR WELDING REPAIRS.===

subject: ARM REST FAILURES
summary: SUMMARY:IN THE MCI RESPONSE TO NHTSA INQUIRY, THE AGENCY LEARNED THAT THESEATS INSTALLED IN THE MCI COACHES WERE MANUFACTURED BY WAKEFIELD.MUCH OFTHE INFORMATION REQUESTED BY NHTSA FROM MCI IS IN THE POSSESSION OFWAKEFIELD.A PE HAS BEEN OPENED AND A INFORMATION REQUEST SENT TOWAKEFIELD TO OBTAIN THIS ADDITIONAL INFORMATION.INFORMATION SUPPLIED BYNTSB HAS SUGGESTED THAT ADDITIONAL BUS MANUFACTURERS MAY ALSO BE INVOLVED,AS WELL AS A MANUFACTURER OF SEAT FRAMES WHICH ARE USED BY WAKEFIELD.BASED ON THE NTSB INVESTIGATION AND THE REPORTS WHICH THEY FURNISHED TONHTSA, THIS PROBLEM MAY HAVE SERIOUS SAFETY IMPLICATIONS.AS MCI IS THEMANUFACTURER OF THE COMPLETED VEHICLE, MCI WOULD HAVE PRIMARYRESPONSIBILITY SHOULD RECALL ACTION BE REQUIRED.===ODI ANALYSIS: CLOSE EXAMINATION OF PHOTOS TAKEN OF THE BUS WHICH WASINVOLVED IN THE SINGLE REPORTED INCIDENT, AND AN ACTUAL EXAMINATION OF AMCI BUS OF THE SAME MODEL AS THE MODEL INVOLVED, INDICATE THAT THE SEAT ARM RESTS WOULD MAKE ALMOST PERFECT SETS OF STAIRS FOR ANYONE TRYING TO EXITFROM THE BUS THROUGH EITHER EMERGENCY EXITS OR THE BUS WINDOWS, IF THE BUSWERE RESTING ON ITS SIDE. AS THIS IS THE ONLY REPORT RECEIVED IN THE 9YEARS THAT THE SEAT HAS BEEN IN PRODUCTION, THE WAKEFIELD ANALYSIS SEEMSREASONABLE (EG) ESCAPING PASSENGERS USED THE ARM RESTS AS A STAIRCASE TOESCAPE THE OVERTURNED BUS, AND THE ARMREST FRACTURES WERE RESULTANT FROMTHAT USE.

subject: RETURN SPRING
summary: SUMMARY:SUBJECT ELECTRONIC PEDALS ARE EQUIPPED WITH A DOUBLE RETURNSPRING.TWO UNITS REPORTEDLY HAVE COMPLETELY FAILED, WITH SEVERAL OTHERSEXPERIENCING A SINGLE SPRING FAILURE.WILLIAMS ATTEMPTED TO ADDRESS THEISSUE WITH A SERVICE BULLETIN MANDATING AN ANNUAL INSPECTION OF THE SUBJECTSPRINGS, AND BIANNUAL REPLACEMENT.THIS PROCEDURE IS DEEMED UNREALISTICFOR OVER THE ROAD TRUCK OPERATORS.FAILURE OF THE SPRINGS RESULTS IN WIDEOPEN THROTTLE.WILLIAMS CURRENTLY IS CONDUCTING A FLEET SURVEY ANDADDITIONAL DURABILITY TESTING TO DETERMINE THE MAGNITUDE OF THE PROBLEM.AT LEAST TWO TRUCKS MANUFACTURERS HAVE ISSUED STRONGLY WORDED SERVICEBULLETINS CONCERNING THIS MATTER.THIS PROBLEM APPEARS TO HAVE SAFETYIMPLICATIONS.ADDITIONAL INFORMATION IS NEEDED.===

subject: CRUISE CONTROL FAILURES
summary: THIS INVESTIGATION DOCUMENTED HTE FUNCTIONAL ABERATIONS THAT HAVE OCCURRED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF THE SUBJECT CRUISE CONTROL SYSTEM.MOST OF THE MALFUNCTIONS INVOLVED FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM TO PROPERLY REGULATE VEHICLE SPEED WHEN ENGAGED, FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM TO ENGAGE, OR SELF-DISENGAGEMENT OF THE SYSTEM. THESE PROBLEMS WERE INVESTIGATED AND STEPS TAKEN BY THE MANUFACTURER TO REMEDY THEIR OCCURRENCES.SERVICE PROCEDURES WERE ISSUED FOR VEHICLES IN USE, AND A DESIGN MODIFICATION MADE FOR NEW VEHICLES.NO CONFIRMED ALLEGATIONS OF FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM TO DISENGAGE UPON COMMAND WERE IDENTIFIED.IMPROVED QUALITY CONTROL PROCEDURES AND DESIGN MODIFICATIONSIN THE SYSTEM WERE UNDERTAKEN TO ENSURE A MORE CONSISTENT LEVEL OF SYSTEM PERFORMANCE.THE DETAILS OF THESE FINDINGS AND THE RESULTING CONCLUSIONS ARE CONTAINED INTHE SUBJECT ENGINEERING ANALYSIS CLOSING REPORT.A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT TREND WAS NOT IDENTIFIED AT EHIS TIME AND FURTHER USE OF AGENCY RESOURCES DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FINDING BY NHTSA THAT A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT DOES NOT EXIST.THE AGENCY WILL TAKE FURTHER ACTION IF WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES.

THESE PROBLEMS WERE INVESTIGATED AND STEPS TAKEN BY THE MANUFACTURER TO REMEDY THEIR OCCURRENCES.SERVICE PROCEDURES WERE ISSUED FOR VEHICLES IN USE, AND A DESIGN MODIFICATION MADE FOR NEW VEHICLES.NO CONFIRMED ALLEGATIONS OF FAILURE OF THE SYSTEM TO DISENGAGE UPON COMMAND WERE IDENTIFIED.IMPROVED QUALITY CONTROL PROCEDURES AND DESIGN MODIFICATIONSIN THE SYSTEM WERE UNDERTAKEN TO ENSURE A MORE CONSISTENT LEVEL OF SYSTEM PERFORMANCE.THE DETAILS OF THESE FINDINGS AND THE RESULTING CONCLUSIONS ARE CONTAINED INTHE SUBJECT ENGINEERING ANALYSIS CLOSING REPORT.A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT TREND WAS NOT IDENTIFIED AT EHIS TIME AND FURTHER USE OF AGENCY RESOURCES DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FINDING BY NHTSA THAT A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT DOES NOT EXIST.THE AGENCY WILL TAKE FURTHER ACTION IF WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES.

subject: STEERING WHEEL SEPARATION
summary: AFTER AN EXTENSIVE INVESTIGATION AND ANALYSIS, CHRYSLER HAS IDENTIFIED THE DEFECT AS A FATIGUE FAILURE, ORIGINATION IN THE HEAT AFFECTED REGION OF THE PROJECTION WELDS OF THE STEERING WHEEL HUB TO STEERING WHEEL ARMATURE ATTACHMENT.THE HUB IS THE PORTION OF THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY THAT CONNECTS IT TO THE STEERING COLUMN SHAFT AND IS ATTACHED TO THE UNDERSIDE OF THE STEERING WHEEL ASSEMBLY BY 4 WELDS.IF CRACKS DEVELOP IN THE HEAT AFFECTED REGION OF THE WELDS AND PROPAGATE THROUGH THE STEERING WHEEL ARMATURE TO EACH OF THE WELDS, THE STEERING WHEEL CAN SEPARATE FROM THE HUB.THIS IS A SLOW PROGRESSIVE FAILURE WHICH NORMALLY OCCURS AT HIGH MILEAGE.IN SOME CASES COMPLAINANTS HAVE REPORTED A LOOSENESS OR WOBBLING OF THE STEERING WHEEL PRIOR TO SEPARATION.TO REMEDY THIS DEFECT, CHRYSLER WILL INSPECT THE STEERING WHEELS OF THE AFFECTED VEHICLES FOR CRACKS IN THE HUB AREA.IF ANY CRACKS ARE FOUND, THE STEERING WHEEL WILL BE REPLACED.ALL OTHER VEHICLES WILL HAVE REINFORCING PLATES INSTALLED WHICH WOULD PREVENT A STEERING WHEEL SEPARATION SHOULD CRACKING OCCUR.

subject: HEADLIGHT FAILURE
summary: EXCESSIVE HEAT IN AN IMPROPERLY MANUFACTURED CIRCUIT BREAKER WITHIN THE HEADLIGHT SWITCH CAUSED THAT CIRCUIT BREAKER TO OPEN FOR TIME PERIODS OF VARYING LENGTH TO COOL OFF.OPENING OF THE CIRCUIT BREAKER IN THIS MANNER INTERRUPTS ELECTRIC CURRENT FLOW TO THE HEADLIGHTS, SHUTTING THEM OFF.HEADLIGHT OUTAGES HAVE RANGER FROM BRIEF FLICKERS (LESS THAN ONE SECOND) TO GREATER THAN 20 SECONDS.OVER TIME, THE OUTAGES GROW IN LENGTH AND DURATION BECAUSE OF HEAT-INDUCED DETERIORATION OF THE SWITCH AND ASSOCIATED WIRING.RECALL 98V-009 WILL APPLY TO APPROXIMATELY 506,000 TAURUS, SABLE, MARK VIII, AND CONTINENTAL VEHICLES PRODUCED FROM 1-DEC.-92 THROUGH 30-SEP-93 AT THE ATLANTA, CHICAGO,AND WIXOM ASSEMBLY PLANTS.87% OF MY 1992-1995 TAURUS/SABLE AND 97% OF MY 1993-1995 MARK VIII WARRANTY REPAIRS (HEADLIGHT SWITCH REPLACEMENT) INVOLVED VEHICLES BUILT DURING THE DEC. 92 - OCT. 93 BUILD RANGE.

subject: SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE SEPARATION
summary: FORD NOTIFIED ODI THAT THEY ARE CONDUCTING A RECALL TO INSPECT AND, AS NECESSARY, REPAIR THE SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENTS ON 1997 FORD F150 VEHICLES BUILT FROM THE BEGINNING OF PRODUCTION THROUGH APRIL OF 1996.ODI'S DATABASE CONTAINS ONE COMPLAINT ALLEGING THE CENTER FRONT SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE WAS NOT BOLTED TO THE FLOOR.FORD HAS LOCATED 60 ADDITIONAL FIELD REPORTS AND WARRANTY CLAIMS THAT APPEAR TO BE THE RESULT OF IMPROPER ASSEMBLY OF OR MISSING SEAT BELT COMPONENTS ON VEHICLES BUILT AT BOTH THE KANSAS CITY AND NORFOLK ASSEMBLY PLANTS.COMPLAINTS ALLEGE THAT A SEAT BELT WAS NOT BOLTED TO THE FLOOR, NOT ATTACHED, NOT HOOKED UP, OR THE OWNER COMPLAINED THAT THE SEAT BELT WAS LOOSE.THE CAUSES HAVE INCLUDED A MISSING BOLT, MISSING NUT, BOLT HOLE NOT THREADED, WELD NUT MISSING, OR BOLT NOT COMPLETELY TIGHTENED INTO ITS MOUNTING HOLE.THE ALLEGED CONDITIONS HAVE OCCURRED IN ALL POTENTIAL SEATING POSITIONS IN THE FRONT AND REAR SEATS IN BOTH THE REGULAR AND SUPER CAB MODELS.FORD'S ANALYSIS OF THEIR COMPLAINTS INDICATE THAT THIS SITUATION OCCURRED PREDOMINANTLY IN VEHICLES BUILT FROM AUGUST 14, 1995 THROUGH APRIL 30 1996.IN LATE APRIL, IN RESPONSE TO THE FIELD REPROTS AND WARRANTY CLAIMS, FORD RETAINED LINE OPERATORS, LINE SUPERVISORS, AND PLANT REPAIR PERSONNEL.OWNERS OF VEHICLES BUILT WITHIN THIS TIME PERIOD WILL BE NOTIFIED OF THE CONDITION AND INSTRUCTED TO RETURN THEIR VEHICLES TO DEALERS FOR INSPECTION OF AND, AS NECESSARY, REPAIR OF SEAT BELT ANCHORAGE ATTACHMENTS.THIS ENGINEERING ANALYSIS IS CLOSED.RECALL 96V-256

subject: FUEL TANK LEAKS
summary: THIS ENGINEERING ANALYSIS WAS OPENED ON JANUARY 31, 1997 BASED ON INFORMATION GATHERED DURING PRELIMINARY EVALUATION (PE), PE96-051. THE PE WAS OPENED ON AUGUST 19, 1996, TO INVESTIGATE ALLEGATIONS OF FUEL LEAKAGE FROM THE AREA WHERE THE FUEL PUMP/SENDING UNIT JOINS THE FUEL TANK.FOR BREVIDY, THIS AREA WILL BE REFERRED TO AS THE PUMP/TANK INTERFACE.THESE ALLEGATIONS WERE FIRST RECEIVED BY ODI ON AUGUST 2, 1996 WHILE INVESTIGATING ALLEGATIONS OF CHRYSLER MINIVAN THROTTLE SHAFT HAND-UP, AND UNCONTROLLED ENGINE SPEED, IN PE96-036.WHILE DISCUSSING THAT ISSUE WITH A FLEET, IT WAS ALLEGED THAT AT LEAST 10(OUT OF 40) 1996 EARLY PRODUCTION CHRYSLER MINIVANS LEAKED FUEL FROM THE PUMP/TANK INTERFACE.ANALYSIS OF THE COMPLAINT AND WARRANTY DATA INDICATE FUEL TANK LEAKAGE INCIDENTS IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES PREDOMINATLY AFFECTED EARLY PRODUCTION VEHICLES.THE DATA INVOLVING CONFIRMED INCIDENTS OF TANK/PUMP INTERFACE LEAKS SUGGEST THAT THOSE FAILURES HAVE BEEN DECLINING SINCE JULY 1996.ODI HAS RECEIVED NO REPORTS OF THE SUBJECT CONDITION INVOLVING ORIGINAL EQUIPMENT PUMPS AND TANKS SINCE SEPTEMBER, 1997.CURRENTLY THIS ISSSUE DOES NOT REQRESENT A CONTINUING FIELD CONCERN.ODI WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR THE SUBJECT VEHICLES FOR FUEL LEAKS OF ANY TYPE.A SAFETY RELATED DEFECT TREND HAS NOT BEEN IDENTIFIED AT THIS TIME AND FURTHER USE OF AGENCY RESOURED DOES NOT APPEAR TO BE WARRANTED.THE CLOSING OF THIS INVESTIGATION DOES NOT CONSTITUTE A FINDING BY NHTSA THAT NO SAFETY RELATED DEFECT EXISTS.THE AGENCY RESERVES THE RIGHT TO TAKE FURTHER ACTION IF WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES.

subject: OVERSENSITIVE AIR BAG DEPLOYMENT
summary: IN MAY OF 1997, ODI UPGRADED TO AN ENGINEERING ANALYSIS WITH 51 COMPLAINTS.ODI IS NOW AWARE OF 88 COMPLAINTS OF ALLEGED INAPPROPRIATE AIRBAG DEPLOYMENTS.TYPICAL COMPLAINTS ALLEGE THAT THE AIRBAGS DEPLOYED AFTER THE VEHICLE HIT A POT HOLE AT BETWEEN 20 AND 45 MPH, OR THAT THE AIRBAGS DEPLOYED WHILE DRIVING AT BETWEEN 20 OR 60 MPH FOR NO APPARENT REASON.APPROXIMATELY 25 DRIVERS ALLEGED THAT THEY DID NOT HIT ANYTHING IN THE ROADWAY.MAZDA WILL CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL OFALL 1995 AND 1996 MODELS OF THE MAZDA 626 AND MX-6, AS WELL AS A SMALL NUMBER OF 1997 MAZDA 626 MODELS, EQUIPPED WITH THE SAME SAS UNIT.THE SAS UNIT CONTROLS THE AIRBAG SYSTEMIT CONTAINS A BUILT-IN CRASH SENSOR TO DETECT VEHICLE DECELERATION DURING A COLLISION.AFFECTED MODELS WERE ASSEMBLED FROM JUNE 1, 1994 THROUGH SEPTEMBER 10, 1996 AND HAVE A VIN WITHIN THE FOLLOWING RANGES: MAZDA 626:1YVGE22**S5300001 THROUGH 1YVGE22**V5599030 MAZDA MX-6: 1YVGE31**S5300001 THROUGH 1YVGE31**T5589965ALL OWNERS WILL BE NOTIFIED OF THE POSSIBILITY THAT THEIR VEHICLE MAY EXPERIENCE AN UNNECESSARY AIRBAG DEPOYMENT IN CERTAIN SITUATIONS.THEY WILL BE INSTRUCTED TO BRING THEIR VEHICLE TO A MAZDA DEALER TO REPROGRAM THE SAS UNIT TO REDUCE THE FREQUENCY OF UNNECESSARY DEPLOYMENTS.

subject: LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT FAILURE
summary: BY LETTER DATED NOVEMBER 6, 1997, THE MANUFACTURER ADVISED THIS AGENCY OF ITS DECISION TO INITIATE A SAFETY RECALL CAMPAIGN OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES TO CORRECT THE DEFECT IDENTIFIED IN THIS EA.THE RECALL WILL ALSO COVER 1996 AND 1997 CHRYSLER CIRRUS/DODGE STRATUS VEHICLES, AS WELL AS 1995 THROUGH 1997 CHRYSLER SEBRING CONVERTIBLE AND PLYMOUTH BREEZE VEHICLES EQUIPPED WITH IDENTICAL LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINTS.AN ESTIMATED TOTAL OF 599,00VEHICLES ARE AFFECTED BY THIS RECALL.THE MANUFACTURER'S INVESTIGATION DISCLOSED THAT PROCESS VARIABILITY, TOGETHER WITH THE BALL JOINT HOUSING COVER CRIMPING OPERATION, CAN RESULT IN AN INEFFECTIVE SEAL THAT PERMITS A LOSS OF LUBRICATION AND ACCELERTED WEAR OF THE BALL JOINT ASSEMBLY.THIS CONDITION CAN LEAD TO FAILURE AND SEPARTION OF THE LOWER CONTROL ARM BALL JOINT.THE RECALL IS IDENTIFIED AS NHTSA 97V-201 AND A COPY OF CHRYSLER'S LETTER TO NHTSA IS ATTACHED HERETO.

subject: FUEL TUBE RETAINING CLIP FAILURE

component: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
subject: FUEL INJECTOR ASSEMBLY LEAKAGE
summary: NITRILE RUBBER SEALS USED IN THE FUEL RAIL ASSEMBLIES OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES AT THE SUPPLY, RETURN, AND CROSSOVER TUBE FITTINGS, AND AT THE PRESSURE REGULATOR FAIL, RESULTING IN FUEL LEAKAGE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.ALSO, THE OUTLET (RIGHT) FUEL RAIL MAY LEAK FROM CRACKS AT CERTAIN MOLD GATES IN THE THERMOSET RAIL MATERIAL.CHRYSLER WILL RECALL THE SUBJECT VEHICLES AND STATED THAT IT INTENDS TO REPLACE THE O-RINGS WITH FLUOROCARBON O-RING HAVING GREATER HEAT RESISTANCE CAPABILITY AND ATTACH REINFORCEMENTS TO THE RAIL IN THE AREAS WHERE THE CRACKING CONCERN HAS BEEN KNOWN TO OCCUR MOST FREQUENTLY.RAILS THAT ARE ALREADY CRACKED WILL BE REPLACED BY NEW, REINFORCED RAILS.

summary: NITRILE RUBBER SEALS USED IN THE FUEL RAIL ASSEMBLIES OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES AT THE SUPPLY, RETURN, AND CROSSOVER TUBE FITTINGS, AND AT THE PRESSURE REGULATOR FAIL, RESULTING IN FUEL LEAKAGE IN THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT.ALSO, THE OUTLET (RIGHT) FUEL RAIL MAY LEAK FROM CRACKS AT CERTAIN MOLD GATES IN THE THERMOSET RAIL MATERIAL.CHRYSLER WILL RECALL THE SUBJECT VEHICLES AND STATED THAT IT INTENDS TO REPLACE THE O-RINGS WITH FLUOROCARBON O-RING HAVING GREATER HEAT RESISTANCE CAPABILITY AND ATTACH REINFORCEMENTS TO THE RAIL IN THE AREAS WHERE THE CRACKING CONCERN HAS BEEN KNOWN TO OCCUR MOST FREQUENTLY.RAILS THAT ARE ALREADY CRACKED WILL BE REPLACED BY NEW, REINFORCED RAILS.

subject: HEADLIGHT CIRCUIT
summary: THE HEADLAMP SWITCH IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES CAN OVER-HEAT AND FAIL RESULTING IN LOSS OF HEAD LAMPS AND POSSIBLY OTHER LIGHTS.DAIMLERCHRYSLER CONDUCTED A SERIES OF TESTS AND DETERMINED THAT THE 3500 SERIES IS PRONE TO GENERATING HEAD LAMP SWITCH TEMPERATURES IN EXCESS OF THE SWITCH LUBRICANT THRESHOLD OF 100 DEGREES CENTIGRADE.WHEN THIS OCCURS, THE LUBRICANT SOLIDIFIES AND ADHERES TO THE SWITCH CONTACH SURFACES INCREASING INTERNAL RESISTANCE AND THERFORE, TEMPERATURE.DAIMLERCHRYSLER INFORMED THE NHTSA THAT IT WOULD INITIATE A RECALL OF 79,3665 MODEL YEAR 1994-1997 DODGE 3500 SERIES RAM TRUCKS ONLY BASED ON ADDITIONAL TESTING FROM WHICH IT DETERMINED THAT THE 1500/2500 SERIES VEHICLES NOMINALLY OPERATE SIGNIFICANTLY BELOW THE TEMPERATURE THRESHOLD OF THE SWITCH LUBRICANT.OWNERS OF 1500/2500 SERIES TRUCKS WERE SENT A NOTIFICATION LETTER ADVISING OF THE PROPER METHODS FOR ADDING AFTERMARKET LIGHTING ACCESSORIES.

subject: SEAT BACK FAILURES

subject: FUEL LEAKS FROM THE VAPOR CANISTER
summary: In January 1998, GM issued the technical service bulletin describing conditions which may result in fuel leakage from the emission vapor canister.According to the bulletin, when the subject vehicles are parked on an incline, with a full tank of gasoline, fuel can flow into the vapor canister.The remedy is to replace of the vapor canister, both rollover valve assembles, and the associated piping.In April 1998, ODI opened Service Query 98-005 to understand GM's rationale for issuance of a service bulletin on a matter that appeared to result in fuel leakage, an issue that is usually address by conducting a safety recall campaign.On November 10, 1998 the SQ was elevated to an Engineering Analysis (EA98-024) to investigate an alleged defect in the fuel tank rollover valve system in certain 1996 through 1997 Chevrolet Trucks and OMC Full Size 010-030 panel and passenger vans.

subject: THROTTLE STICKING
summary: ON JANUARY 23, 1997, FORD MOTOR COMPANY ISSUED SPECIAL SERVICE MESSAGE (SSM) 10240, ANNOUNCING THAT A REVISED THROTTLE BODY WOULD BE AVAILABLE DURING THE FIRST QUARTER OF 1997 FOR 1997 MODEL YEAR FORD EXPLORERS EQUIPPED WITH THE 4.0L SINGLE OVERHEAD CAM (SOHC) ENGINE.THE SSM STATED THE REVISED THROTTLE BODY WOULD ADDRESS INCREASED THROTTLE EFFORTS THAT HAD BEEN EXPERIENCED ON THESE VEHICLES.ON JULY 31, 1998, THE OFFICE OF DEFECTS INVESTIGATION (ODI) OPENED SERVICE QUERY SQ98-014 TO DETERMINE WHETHER A SAFETY RECALL WAS WARRANTED FOR THE PROBLEM ADDRESSED BY SSM 10240.AT THAT TIME ODI HAD 14 REPORTS ALLEGING THROTTLES STICKING OPEN, INCLUDING THREE CRASHES, ON 1997 EXPLORERS WITH THE 4.0L SOHC ENGINE.EA99-001 INVESTIGATED ALLEGED THROTTLE BODY STICKING, AND LOSS OF THROTTLE CONTROL, IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.ON DECEMBER 22, 2000, FORD MOTOR COMPANY FILED A DEFECT INFORMATION REPORT CONCERNING THROTTLE BODY STICKING IN 1997-1998 MODEL YEAR EXPLORER AND MOUNTAINEER VEHICLES WITH 4.0 SOHC ENGINES THAT STILL RETAIN THE ORIGINAL THROTTLE BODY; SAFETY RECALL 00V-422.THE ENGINEERING ANALYSIS CLOSING REPORT IS ATTACHED.

REAR SHOULDER BELT MALFUNCTION
summary: THE ALLEGED DEFECT CONCERNS TWO MAJOR SYMPTOMS:FAILURE TO RETRACT WEBBING AND INABILITY TO EXTEND THE WEBBINNG FOR USE. THE ROOT CAUSE OF THESE SYMPTOMS IS THE DESIGN OF THE TRIM BEZEL THROUGH WHICH THE SEBBING PASSES. BUILT INTO THE REAR PACKAGE SHELF, THE BEZEL INCLUDES A VERTICAL SLOT TO FACILITATE VEHICLE ASSEMBLY.THE SLOT IS POSITIONED SUCH THAT THE SHOULDER BELT WEBBING TENDS TO SLIP INTO IT.WEBBING INGESTION BY THE VERTICAL SLOT MAY RETARD WEBBING RETRACTION, OR ALLOW WEBBING TWISTS TO ACCUMULATE ON THE RETRACTOR SPOOL.IN EITHER CASE, THE RETRACTOR MAY FAIL TO MAINTAIN APPROPRIATE TENSION ON THE SEAT OCCUPANT.FAILURE OF THE SHOULDER BELT TO COMPLETELY RETRACT MAY ALSO RESULT IN AN INABILITY TO EXTEND IT FOR USE IF THE CHILD RESTRAINT CINCH FEATURE HAS BEEN INADVERTENTLY ENGAGE (BY EXTENDING THE WEBBING TO ITS MAXIMUM LENGTH).GM WILL REMEDY THE ALLEGED DEFECT IN THE SUBJECT VEHICLES BY STRAIGHTENING AN TWISTED REAR SHOULDER BELT WEBBING AND THEM INSTALLING A PLASTIC COVER THAT WILL PREVENT FURTHER WEBBING INGESTION BY THE WEBBING GUIDE VERTICAL SLOT.THIS ENGINEERIGN ANANLYSIS IS CLOSED.

summary: ODI has received 50 additional complaiints on MY 1993 Ford Taurus and Mercury Sable vehicles alleging malfunction of the windshield wiper system including; intermittent or complete stoppage of wiper sweeping; inadequate sweep speed; and other general complaints of poor performace.In some cases, the owner alleges havingto leave the roadway or roll down the window and manually restart the sweeping motion of the wiper arms.Other complaints allege that the wiper sweeps too slowly at the maximum speed setting resulting in inadequate vision during heavy precipition.Some complaints allge repeated wiper system malfunctions despirt having their vehicles serviced at Ford dealerships of replacement of the multi-function switch and/or wiper motor.Ford provided its response to an Information Request Letter indicating that the same wiper motor is used on the MY 1987-1993 Taurus and Sable; however, warranty and complaint data show that the MY 1993 is over represented and may warrant particular attention.An Engineering Ananlysis is necessary to determine if a potential safety defect exists.

subject: WINDSHIELD WIPER
summary: BY LETTER DATED DECEMBER 12, 1999, GM NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ITS PLANS TO CONDUCT A SAFETY RELATED DEFECT CAMPAIGN TO REMEDY 155,149 OF THE SUBJECT VEHICLES.THE VEHICLE POPULATION FOR THE CAMPAIGN INCLUDES THE 1997 BUICK REGAL/CENTURY AND PONTIAC GRAN PRIX MODELS BUILT DURING THE PERIOD FROM THE START OF PRODUCTION THROUGH MAY 1, 1997.GM DETERMINED THAT THE WIPERS INSTALLED PRIOR TO THIS DATE COULD STOP WORKING, USUALLY DURING HEAVY LOAD CONDITIONS, DUE TO SEPARATION BETWEEN THE DRIVE PIN AND THE CRESCENT IN THE WIPER CRANK ARM ASSEMBLY.EFFECTIVE MAY 1, 1997,GM CORRECTED THIS PROBLEM IN PRODUCTION BY MODIFYING THE DRIVE PIN AND STRENGTHENING THE CRESCENT.THESE SAME IMPROVED PARTS WILL BE INSTALLED IN THE VEHICLES TO BE RECALLED.THE SCOPE OF THE CAMPAIGN WILL INCLUDE ALL VEHICLES PRODUCED PRIOR TO THE MAY 1, 1997 CORRECTION (THE OLDSMOBILE INTRIQUE PRODUCTION DID NOT START UNTIL AFTER MAY 1, 1997, AND IS THEREFORE NOT INCLUDED).VEHICLES WITH THE SCOPE OF THIS INVESTIGATION AND PRODUCED AFTER MAY 1, 1997, CONTAIN THE MORE ROBUST CRESCENT AND IMPROVED PIN DESIGN AND ARE NOT INCLUDED IN THE RECALL CAMPAIGN.ODI WILL CONTINUE TO MONITOR COMPLAINT REPORTS ON THE VEHICLES PRODUCED AFTER MAY 1, 1997 AND RESERVES THE RIGHT TO TAKE FURTHER ACTION IF WARRANTED BY THE CIRCUMSTANCES.BASED ON GM'S RECALL ACTION (ODI 99V-348) THIS INVESTIGATION IS CLOSED.

subject: STEERING COLUMN FIRES
summary: ODI has received 33 complaints alleging excessive heat in the ignition switch and related circuitry in 1994-1996 Dodge Ram trucks.The root cause is an excessive current draw through the ignition switch result in fire, smoke, melting of surrounding plastics, stalling and the illumination of air bag and anti-lock brake system (ABS) warnig lights. DaimlerChrsler has been aware of the potential for this failure and implemented a design change to reduce the current draw through the switch.This design change involved the installation of a relay in the blower motor circuitry for all Ram trucks built after March 15,1996.DaimlerChrysler also made available an ignition switch repair package (PN 4874996) which includes the necessary components to upgrade vehicles built prior to the implementation date.DaimleChrysler also issued a correspondence to its zones instructing technicians to replace failed ignition switches in the subject population with the sevice kit only.An Engineering Analysis is necessary to determine if a safety defect trend exists.ODI will focus its investigation on fires in the steering column area as well as the effects of switch failure on the ABS and air bag system.

subject: DUAL FUEL TANK CROSSFLOW/LEAKAGE
summary: ON JULY 14, 1993 FORD FILED A DEFECT INFORMATION REPORT CONCERNING FUEL TANK CROSS FLOW LEAKAGE ON F-SERIES LIGHT TRUCKS AND CAB CHASSIS BUILT FROM JULY 22, 1989 THROUGH DECEMBER 17, 1992.THE REMEDY WAS TO REPLACE THE FUEL PRESSURE REGULATOR AND INSTALL A CHECK VALVE BETWEEN EACH FUEL SUPPLY LINE AND FUEL TANK (2) TO REPAIR THE SUPPLY SIDE FUEL CROSS FLOW PROBLEM (RECALL 93V-125).ODI OPENED RQ98-008 ON MAY 29, 1998 BECAUSE OF THE LARGE NUMBER OF ALLEGED REMEDY FAILURES AND REPORTS OF FUEL CROSS FLOW ON VEHICLES OUTSIDE OF THE RECALL POPULATION.BASED ONTHE INFORMATION RECEIVED FROM FORD ON AUGUST 11, SEPTEMBER 30, AND DECEMBER 15, 1998, AND THE INCREASING TREND OF REMEDY FAILURES AND OUT OF SCOPE CROSSFLOW REPORTS, ODI OPENED EA99-032 ON NOVEMBER 4, 1999.THE ATTACHED ENGINEERING ANALYSIS CLOSING REPORT FULLY DESCRIBES THE RESULTS OF THIS INVESTIGATION AND REASON FOR CLOSING.THE SUBJECT VEHICLES CAN EXPERIENCE FUEL TRANSFER FROM ONE TANK TO THE OTHER DUE TO MALFUNCTIONS IN THE FUEL SYSTEM.WHEN FUEL IS PUMPED OR RETURNED TO THE NON-OPERATING TANK (CROSS FLOW), THE CAPACITY OF THE NON-OPERATING TANK CAN BE EXCEEDED, CAUSING FUEL TO OVERFLOW PAST THE FILLER CAP, CREATING A FIRE POTENTIAL.

subject: BOAT TRAILER DISC BRAKE LOCKUP
summary: After receiving a report from a Florida boat dealer alleging certain hydraulic surge brake calipers manufactured by Tie Down Engineering freeze on the caliper carrier pins, ODI opened PE99-034.During the course of conducting the PE, ODI has found that numerous performance failures have occurred involving Tie Down's boat trailer brake calipers.Since their introduction in June 1997, the calipers have been upgraded at least 3 times.In all, Tie Down has made more than 18 changes to the calipers addressing complaints received from trailer manufacturers, distributors, retailers, and owners.Most of these complaints related to the original caliper (GEN1) producted from June, 1998 through September, 1998.The two most serious complaints lodged by those familiar with the system, involve inadvertent brake lock-up while towing at speed and brake fluid leakage from the caliper/poston interface (the allege cause of the crash).To clarify these and other issues, we have upgraded the PE to this EA.

subject: REFUELING SPIT BACK
summary: The number and dates of complaints and warrant claims reported by Kia indicates that fuel spit-back has been a serieous ongoing problem with the Sephia models.Kia has made changes in both the ORVR valve and in the installation process on the fuel tank check valve, in an attempt to correct the problem.The failure of the check valve, due to cracking during installation, could go undetected until problems develop with the ORVR valve.Should an ORVR valve malfunction, when the vehicle has a tank chech valve with a latent crack, significant fuel spitting out the fuel filler pipe during refueling is possible.Current owners of 1998 and 1999 models could still be driving vehicles with latent defects.

component: FUEL SYSTEM, GASOLINE:DELIVERY:HOSES, LINES/PIPING, AND FITTINGS
subject: CUMMINS ENGINES / FUEL LINE BRACKETS
summary: NEW FLYER INDUSTRIES LTD. SUBMITTED A DEFECT AND NONCOMPLIANCE INFORMATION REPORT INVOLVING CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES BUILT WITH CUMMINS ISL AND ISC DIESEL ENGINES.NEW FLYER FOUND THAT THESE ENGINES CONTAIN HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINES THAT CAN FAIL FROM EXCESSIVE VIBRATION.IF A HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE FAILS AND ATOMIZED FUEL IS LEAKED INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT, A FIRE IS POSSIBLE.RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 28 VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS IN JANUARY 2008.GILLIG CORPORATION RESPONDED THAT THEY HAD PREVIOUSLY FILED A DEFECT REPORT IN NOVEMBER 2006.BLUE BIRD BODY COMPANY, NOVA BUS INC, ELDORADO NATIONAL, AND NORTH AMERICAN BUS INDUSTRIES AGREED THAT A SAFETY DEFECT WAS EVIDENT IN THE ENGINES AND CHOSE TO FILE DEFECT REPORTS ACCORDINGLY.THE REMAINING 23 OEMS RESPONDED STATING NO ISSUE HAS EVER BEEN FOUND, THESE ENGINES WERE NEVER RECEIVED, OR THAT THEIR PARTICULAR APPLICATION IS CONSIDERABLY DIFFERENT THAN THE TRANSIT BUS ENGINE INSTALLATIONS AND NO ACTION IS NECESSARY.SINCE THE OPENING OF THIS EQ, CUMMINS HAS CHOSEN TO CONDUCT A FIELD CAMPAIGN TO REPAIR THE AFFECTED ENGINES FOR ON-HIGHWAY APPLICATIONS.THE OEM RESPONSE LIST CAN BE FOUND IN THE EQ REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

SUBMITTED A DEFECT AND NONCOMPLIANCE INFORMATION REPORT INVOLVING CERTAIN TRANSIT BUSES BUILT WITH CUMMINS ISL AND ISC DIESEL ENGINES.NEW FLYER FOUND THAT THESE ENGINES CONTAIN HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINES THAT CAN FAIL FROM EXCESSIVE VIBRATION.IF A HIGH PRESSURE FUEL LINE FAILS AND ATOMIZED FUEL IS LEAKED INTO THE ENGINE COMPARTMENT, A FIRE IS POSSIBLE.RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 28 VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS IN JANUARY 2008.GILLIG CORPORATION RESPONDED THAT THEY HAD PREVIOUSLY FILED A DEFECT REPORT IN NOVEMBER 2006.BLUE BIRD BODY COMPANY, NOVA BUS INC, ELDORADO NATIONAL, AND NORTH AMERICAN BUS INDUSTRIES AGREED THAT A SAFETY DEFECT WAS EVIDENT IN THE ENGINES AND CHOSE TO FILE DEFECT REPORTS ACCORDINGLY.THE REMAINING 23 OEMS RESPONDED STATING NO ISSUE HAS EVER BEEN FOUND, THESE ENGINES WERE NEVER RECEIVED, OR THAT THEIR PARTICULAR APPLICATION IS CONSIDERABLY DIFFERENT THAN THE TRANSIT BUS ENGINE INSTALLATIONS AND NO ACTION IS NECESSARY.SINCE THE OPENING OF THIS EQ, CUMMINS HAS CHOSEN TO CONDUCT A FIELD CAMPAIGN TO REPAIR THE AFFECTED ENGINES FOR ON-HIGHWAY APPLICATIONS.THE OEM RESPONSE LIST CAN BE FOUND IN THE EQ REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: DANA CORPORATION DRIVESHAFTS
summary: DANA CORPORATION HAS IDENTIFIED CERTAIN REMANUFACTURED DRIVESHAFTS AS BEING DEFECTIVE.REAR PROPELLER SHAFTS SENT TO A 3RD PARTY FOR REWORKING HAVE BEEN IMPROPERLY HEAT TREATED CAUSING IMPAIRED OPERATIONAL STRENGTH OF THE YOKE ALUMINIUM SHAFT.IF THIS REAR PROPELLER SHAFT SEPERATES AND COMES INTO CONTACT WITH THE ROAD, THE DRIVER MAY LOSE CONTROL OF THE VEHICLE AND A CRASH CAN OCCUR.IF THE REAR PROPELLER SHAFT COMES INTO CONTACT WITH FUEL TANK, A FUEL LEAK CAN OCCUR WHICH CAN LEAD TO A FIRE.AN INFORMATION REQUEST LETTER WAS MAILED TO FORD ON 1/22/08 REQUESTING FORD'S REASONING IN DETERMINING NO SAFETY DEFECT IS PRESENT IN SAID DANA DRIVESHAFTS.FORD RESPONDED TO RMD'S LETTER ON 2/18/2008 STATING THESE DRIVESHAFTS WERE UTLIZED IN THE 2007 RANGER 4X4 AND THE 2007 EXPLOER 4X2 VEHICLES. FORD STATED THAT EVALUATIONS WERE CONDUCTED TO ASSESS THE STRENGTH OF THE DRIVESHAFTS AND IT WAS FOUND THEY RETAINED AN ULTIMATE STRENGTH GREATER THAN THAT NEEDED ON THESE PARTICULAR FORD APPLICATIONS.FORD STATED THAT THE DODGE AND TOYOTA VEHICLES THAT UTILIZED THESE DRIVESHAFTS OPERATE AT A HIGHER YOKE SHAFT INPUT TORQUE THAN THE RANGER OR EXPLORER.FORD STATED NO OWNER REPORTS, FIELD REPORTS, OR WARRANTY CLAIMS COULD BE FOUND RELATED TO THESE DRIVESHAFTS.FORD DID NOTE THAT SEPERATION OF THE DRIVESHAFT FROM TRANSMISSION END IS POSSIBLE WITH CONTINUED DRIVER ABUSE FOUND IN ACTIONS LIKE DUMPING THE CLUTCH.HOWEVER, VEHICLE VIBRATION WOULD BE EVIDENT ALERTING THE NEED FOR SERVICE TO THE DRIVER.FORD CONCLUDED THAT THIS DOES NOT PRESENT AN UNREASONABLE RISK TO VEHICLE SAFETY AND WILL NOT BE FILING A DEFECT REPORT.THIS REPORT WILL BE FORWARDED TO THE DEFECTS ASSESMENT DIVISION FOR FURTHER REVIEW.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: HANGZHOU REPLACEMENT REAR WINDOW GLASS
summary: SAFELITE FULFILLMENT, INC. SUBMITTED A 573 DEFECT AND NONCOMPLIANCE INFORMATION REPORT ON 11/19/2007 REGARDING CERTAIN REPLACEMENT REAR WINDOW GLASS MANUFACTURED BY HANGZHOU SAFETY GLASS CO., LTD.SAFELITE DISCOVERED THAT THREE DOT 430 PART NUMBERS DIFFERED IN COLOR AND OTHER NON-STRUCTURAL COMPONENTS WHICH COULD CAUSE THE TEMPERED GLASS TO BREAK INTO LARGER PIECES THAN CONSIDERED ACCEPTABLE.LARGE SHARDS OF GLASS POSE A SAFETY RISK TO OCCUPANTS INSIDE A MOTOR VEHICLE.RMD RECEIVED AN ADDITIONAL DEFECT REPORT FROM POLYMER PROCESS DEVELOPMENT (PPD) ON 3/6/08 SHORTLY AFTER THIS EQ WAS OPENED.PPD STATED THEIR NONCOMPLIANT GLASS WAS ALSO RECEIVED FROM WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE. RMD MAILED AN INFORMATION REQUEST LETTER TO WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE ON 4/4/08 REQUESTING THE REASON WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE HAD NOT FILED A DEFECT REPORT FOR THIS NONCOMPLIANCE.WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE REPLIED ON 4/15/08 THAT COMPANY RERESENTATIVES WERE SENT TO CHINA TO SPEAK WITH THE MANUFACTURER AND DEMAND AN INVESTIGATION.WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE ALSO STATED THAT THEY WERE WORKING WITH AN INDEPENDENT LAB TO VERIFY THE NONCOMPLIANCE AND THAT THEIR CUSTOMERS WOULD BE NOTIFIED OF THE ISSUE ONCE/IF CONFIRMED.AFTER MORE THAN 30 DAYS WITH NO RESPONSE, RMD AGAIN WROTE WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE ON 5/28/08 REQUESTING THE LAB RESULTS.A RESPONSE WAS RECEIVED ON 6/11/08 STATING WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE WAS HAVING DIFFICULTY IN FINDING A REASONABLY PRICED LABORATORY TO CONDUCT THE TESTING.RMD MET WITH OVSC TO DISCUSS THE POSSIBILITY OF NHTSA CONDUCTING FURTHER NONCOMPLIANCE TESTING ON THE RECALLED REPLACEMENT GLASS.AT PRESENT, NO STANDARD PROCESS EXISTS FOR GLAZING TESTING WITHIN NHTSA.IT WAS QUESTIONED WHETHER THE COMPANIES RECALLING THE GLASS (SAFELITE & PPD) ALTERED THE GLASS IN ANYWAY THAT COULD TRANSFER RECALL RESPONSIBILITY TO THEIR BEHALF AS THE FINAL MANUFACTURER OF THE GLASS.AFTER INQUIRES TO BOTH COMPANIES IN EARLY JULY, IT WAS DISCOVERED THAT THE GLASS IS IMPORTED PRE-CUT & GLAZED FOR FINAL INSTALLATION.WITH THIS INFORMATION IT BECAME CLEAR THAT RECALL RESPONSIBILITY FOR THIS ISSUE STILL LIES WITH THE REGISTERED IMPORTER, WHOLESALE AUTOMOTIVE.THIS INVESTIGATION MATERIAL WILL BE TRANSFERRED TO OVSC FOR POSSIBLE FURTHER INVESTIGATION AND NONCOMPLIANCE TESTING.THIS INVESTIGATION IS CLOSED.

subject: MAXON LIFT CORP. WHEELCHAIR LIFTS
summary: MAXON LIFT CORP. HAS IDENTIFIED CERTAIN EARLY MODEL WHEELCHAIR LIFTS AS BEING NONCOMPLIANT WITH FMVSS.CERTAIN WL-7 & & WL-7A WHEELCHAIR LIFTS FAIL TO MEET 49 CFR 571.403 S6.4.7.3 INDICATING THE LIFTS MAY SEPARATE, FRACTURE, OR BREAK BEARING WEIGHT UP TO 1,600 LBS. IF A WHEELCHAIR LIFT WERE TO BREAK OR SEPARATE WHILE DEPLOYED, AN OCCUPANT COULD FALL, FROM A HEIGHT UP TO 4 FEET, AND EXPERIENCE SERIOUS, PERSONEL INJURY AND/OR EQUIPMENT DAMAGE.RMD MAILED 20 COMPANIES INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS IN MID-APRIL.IN MOST CASES, THESE COMPANIES WERE INSTALLATION SHOPS OR REPAIR SHOPS ONLY.DEFECT REPORTS WERE RECEIVED FROM INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION (08V-212) AND THOMAS BUILT BUSSES (08V-321).A WRITTEN RESPONSE WAS NEVER RECEIVED FROM IBERT GRANITE & MARBLE INC. BUT, THROUGH PHONE CONVERSATION, IT WAS DISCOVERED IBERT IS A GRAVESTONE MANUFACTURER AND THE GIVEN ADDRESS DOES NOT RECEIVE U.S. MAIL.WHERE APPLICABLE, MOST RESPONDANTS WERE DIRECTED BACK TO MAXON TO PASS ALONG END-USE CUSTOMER CONTACT INFORMATION.THIS EQ SHOULD HAVE RAISED RECALL AWARENESS AND GIVEN MAXON THE OPPROTUNITY TO REPAIR ADDITIONAL WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.IR RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.

subject: BENDIX SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MOD. VALVES
summary: ON 6/7/07 BENDIX FILED A 573 DEFECT INFORMATION REPORT STATING CERTAIN SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVES MIGHT INTERMITTENTLY FAIL.UNAUTHORIZED CHANGES TO THE MANUFACTURING OF THESE VALVES CAN CAUSE THE INTERNAL CHECK VALVE RUBBER TO BECOME DEFORMED.THIS CAN CREATE A LEAK THAT MAY DELAY THE APPLICATION OF THE PARKING BRAKE, IN SOME CASES LEADING TO A VEHICLE ROLLAWAY.A ROLLAWAY EVENT MIGHT CAUSE DAMAGE TO PERSONAL PROPERTY AND/OR HARM TO OTHER MOTORISTS/PEDESTRIANS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 6 VEHICLE OEMS ON 5/22/08.IN RESPONSE TO THIS LETTER, KOVATCH MOBILE EQUIPMENT FILED 08V-263, SELECT TRUCKS REFURBISH CENTER IS A SUBSIDIARY OF DAIMLER?S AND COVERED UNDER 07V-302, AND SST TRUCK COMPANY IS A SUBSIDIARY OF IC CORP AND COVERED UNDER 07V-314.LINK-BELT CONSTRUCTION EQUIPMENT AND ROSENBAUER MOTORS DID NOT USE THESE VALVES CERTIFIED FOR HIGHWAY USE BUT WILL HAVE THEIR UNITS REPAIRED.PROTECTED VEHICLES INC. RETURNED ALL THEIR RECALLED EQUIPMENT TO BENDIX IN EARLY 2007.IR RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: BENDIX SOLD PARKER SINGLE CHECK VALVES
summary: ON 6/7/07 BENDIX FILED A 573 DEFECT INFORMATION REPORT STATING CERTAIN PARKER SINGLE CHECK VALVES MIGHT BECOME EXCESSIVELY WORN OVER TIME AND BREAK APART.IF THIS VALVE BREAKS APART AND BECOMES LODGED INSIDE THE SR-7 SPRING BRAKE MODULATING VALVE, A DELAY IN THE PARKING BRAKE APPLICATION IS POSSIBLE.THIS DELAY CAN LEAD TO A VEHICLE ROLLAWAY.A ROLLAWAY EVENT MIGHT CAUSE DAMAGE TO PERSONAL PROPERTY AND/OR HARM TO OTHER MOTORISTS/PEDESTRIANS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 10 VEHICLE OEMS ON 6/11/2008.AS THIS BENDIX RECALL WAS FOR REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT PERTAINING TO BENDIX 07E-037, MANY VEHICLE OEMS (WITHOUT STATING SO) COMBINED THE TWO RECALLS INTO ONE VEHICLE RECALL.KOVATCH MOBILE EQUIPMENT,NABI, SELECT TRUCKS REFURBISH CENTER, GM, THOMAS BUILT BUSES, AND AMERICAN TRUCK COMPANY ALL FILED 1 VEHICLE RECALL TO INCLUDE REPLACEMENT EQUIPMENT FROM BENDIX 07E-038.OSHKOSH TRUCK CORP AND PREVOST CAR RESPONDED THAT THEY DID NOT USE THESE VALVES.SPARTAN MOTORS USED THESE PRODUCTS IN OFF-ROAD VEHICLES ONLY.ISLAND CITY ENGINEERING INSTALLED THESE ON PT UNITS USED FOR FMVSS TESTING ONLY.IR RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 21 VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS ON 6/17/2008.OF THOSE RESPONSES, MONACO COACH, COACHMEN, TRAVEL UNITS, & WINNEBAGO HAD FILED DEFECT REPORTS PRIOR TO RECEIVING RMD'S NOTICE, ALFA LEISURE'S LETTER WAS RETURNED AS THEY WENT OUT OF BUSINESS ON 4/30/2008, AND SEVERAL COMPANIES WERE BOAT MODIFIERS THAT WOULD NOT FILE DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA.10 VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS FILED A DEFECT REPORT WITH NHTSA AND NOTIFIED THEIR CUSTOMER BASE ACCORDINGLY. THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY IS CLOSED. IR RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.

RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

A FIRE CAN CAUSE PERSONAL INJURY TO VEHICLE OCCUPANTS. RMD MAILED INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS TO 227 COMPANIES ON 7/1/2008 AND AGAIN ON 9/30/2008.FROM THOSE MAILINGS, 78 COMPANIES INSTALLED THESE REFRIGERATORS INTO MOTOR VEHICLES AND SUBSEQUENTLY FILED DEFECT REPORTS WITH NHTSA, 89 COMPANIES SUBMITTED WRITTEN RESPONSES BUT WERE NOT REQUIRED TO FILE A DEFECT REPORT, AND 28 COMPANIES FAILED TO SUBMIT A WRITTEN RESPONSE TO RMD'S INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS.32 LETTERS WERE UNDELIVERABLE.NOTES FOR EACH MAILING CAN BE FOUND ATTACHED BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.
