4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

4/1/2005 AND 10/9/07, AS FAILING TO COMPLY WITH THE THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.4.THESE LIFTS' THRESHOLD WARNING SYSTEM MIGHT NOT ACTIVATE IF A MOBILITY AID (SUCH AS A WHEELCHAIR) MOVES TOWARD A CERTAIN POINT IN THE THRESHOLD AREA.SHOULD THIS SYSTEM NOT OPERATE PROPERLY, THE WHEELCHAIR LIFT OCCUPANT MIGHT FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.RICON SUBMITTED ANOTHER NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT (07E-097) FOR THE S SERIES & K SERIES WHEELCHAIR LIFTS, ENCOMPASSING SOME OF THE LIFTS FROM THE ABOVE RECALL.MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 4/1/05 AND 6/6/2006, CERTAIN LIFTS MAY FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THEIR ANTI-STOW INTERLOCK REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 403 S7.THE PRESSURE SENSING SWITCH THAT DETECTS WEIGHT ON THE PLATFORM MIGHT NOT BE ADJUSTED TO THE PROPER SENSITIVITY LEVEL.THESE LIFTS MIGHT BEGIN TO TILT TOWARD THE VEHICLE AND BEGIN TO STOW WHILE AN OCCUPANT IS STILL ON THE LIFT.THIS MAY CAUSE THE OCCUPANT TO SLIDE OR FALL FROM THE LIFT AND SUFFER INJURY.ON SEPTEMBER 8, 2008 RMD MAILED LETTERS TO 183 COMPANIES, WHICH CONSTITUTED THE ENTIRETY OF RICON'S CUSTOMER LIST FOR THE RECALLED PRODUCTS, ADVISING THEM OF RICON'S RECALL AND REQUESTING THAT THEY FILE THEIR REQUIRED REPORTS.RMD FOLLOWED THAT MAILING WITH A2ND IR LETTERON 11/17/2008.AS A RESULT OF THOSE MAILINGS, A TOTAL OF 53 COMPANIES DECIDED TO SUBMIT A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT AND CONDUCT A SAFETY RECALL FOR THE VEHICLES THEY MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED AS NEW VEHICLES WITH THE INSTALLATION OF THESE RECALLED WHEELCHAIR LIFTS.A TOTAL OF 95 RECALLS (MANY COMPANIES FILING A REPORT FOR EACH RECALL) WERE RECEIVED AS A RESULT OF THESE INITIAL MAILINGS.IN THE COURSE OF THE EQ, IT WAS LEARNED THAT ONE OF RICON'S CUSTOMERS, VANTAGE MOBILITY INTERNATIONAL (VMI), ACTUALLY DISTRIBUTED ITS WHEELCHAIR LIFTS TO HUNDREDS OF OTHER COMPANIES.VMI HAD NOTIFIED MANY OF ITS CUSTOMERS OF THE RICON RECALLS, BUT NONE OF THOSE COMPANIES HAD NOTIFIED NHTSA OF ANY NEW VEHICLES MANUFACTURED OR ALTERED WITH THIS EQUIPMENT.ON JUNE 17-19, 2009 RMD MAILED 502 ADDIONAL IR LETTERS.THESE LETTERS CONTAINED A SET OF QUESTIONS ASKING IF THE RECALLED LIFTS WERE INSTALLED INTO NEW OR USED VEHICLES AND ALSO ASKED IF VIN INFORMATION WAS RECORDED BY THE COMPANY.IN THE EVENT THE COMPANIES WOULD NOT BE ABLE TO NOTIFY THEIR CUSTOMERS, RMD WANTED TO KNOW IF VIN INFORMATION COULD BE TRANSMITTED BACK TO RICON FOR PROPER CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS BASED ON STATE REGISTRATION RECORDS.A TOTAL OF 17 COMPANIES FILED 31 NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS AS A RESULT OF THE JUNE 2009 MAILING.A TOTAL OF 126 SAFETY RECALLS WERE CONDUCTED AS A RESULT OF THIS EQUIPMENT QUERY.A TOTAL OF 258 COMPANIES FAILED TO RESPOND TO RMD'S IR LETTERS AND THEY WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNSEL FOR FURTHER ACTION.TOTALS AND THE EQ MAILING SPREADSHEET ARE ATTACHED BELOW AND AVAILABLE IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: LTR TIRES HANGZHOU ZHONGCE RUBBER CO. LT
summary: THIS PURSUIT IS BEING PULLED FORWARD FOR PUBLIC VIEW AND REPLACES EQ 07-002. TIRES IMPORTED BY FOREIGN TIRE SALES (FTS) THAT WERE FABRICATED BY HANGZHOU ZHONGCE RUBBER CO. LTD (HZR) IN CHINA HAVE BEEN DECLARED, BY FTS, TO CONTAIN A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT (NHTSA RECALL NO. 07T-003).LIGHT TRUCK RADIAL TIRES CARRYING THE WESTLAKE, COMPASS AND YKS BRANDS IN THE FOLLOWING SIZES AND MODELS WITH A PHASE II BUILD DATE RANGE (SHOWN AS THE LAST FOUR DIGITS IN THE DOT NUMBER) OF 0404 (FOURTH WEEK OF 2004) THROUGH 0206 (SECOND WEEK OF 2006), ARE INVOLVED.SIZEMODELDOT NO.LT235/75R-15 CR861, CR857 7DT5FTS...LT235/85R-16 CR860, CR861, CR8577DT2FTS...LT245/75R-16 CR860, CR861, CR857 7DT3FTS...LT265/75R-16 CR860, CR861, CR857 7DT4FTS...LT31X10.5 R-15 CR857, CR861 7DT6FTS... PHASE I TIRES, WITH A BUILD DATE RANGE OF JOB 1 THROUGH 0404, CONTAINED A C-SHAPED BELT-EDGE (GUM) STRIP.PHASE III TIRES, BUILD DATE RANGE 0306 THROUGH CURRENT PRODUCTION, REPORTEDLY INCORPORATE BELT-EDGE WEDGES AND NYLON EDGE STRIPS IN AN EFFORT TO MEET THE MORE STRINGENT HIGH-SPEED TEST INCLUDED IN FMVSS 139.AT THIS TIME, NO DECISION HAS BEEN MADE THAT A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT EXISTS IN EITHER PHASE I OR PHASE III TIRES.GUM STRIPS ARE A COMMON, BUT NOT MANDATORY, COMPONENT USED TO SLOW THE SEPARATION OF BELTS TO BEYOND THE USEFUL LIFE OF THE TIRE.FOR PHASE II, HZR ELIMINATED THE C-SHAPED GUM STRIPS PRESENT IN PHASE I TIRES, ALLEGEDLY WITHOUT INFORMING FTS OF THIS CHANGE.WHEN FTS DISCOVERED THE CHANGE, IT DECIDED THAT CONSTITUTED A SAFETY-RELATED DEFECT, AND RECALLED ITS PHASE II TIRES, 07T-003.THE PURPOSE OF THIS INVESTIGATION WAS TO DETERMINE IF OTHER TIRE IMPORTERS, INCLUDING THOSE IMPLICATED BY FTS IN THEIR DEFECT INFORMATION REPORT DATED JUNE 11, 2007, IMPORTED TIRES OF SIMILAR CONSTRUCTION TO THOSE INVOLVED IN RECALL 07T-003.THE SEVENTEEN (17) TIRE IMPORTERS THAT WERE SENT INFORMATION REQUESTS IN ASSOCIATION WITH THIS INVESTIGATION ARE; AIR LAND SEA-WAYS INC., CAMBRIDGE, CARIBBEAN RUBBER, COOPER TIRE, DUNLAP & KYLE CO, EBEN, INC., GOMERA GOVI, INC., GOODYEAR, K&D TIRE, OMNI UNITED, ORTECK INTERNATIONAL INC., ROBISON TIRE, STRATEGIC IMPORT SUPPLY, TIRECO INC., TYRES INTERNATIONAL INC., UNIVERSAL TIRE, AND VICTOR MORALIES & ASSOC.INFORMATION WAS ALSO OBTAINED FROM FTS AND HZR IN THIS INVESTIGATION.HZR CONFIRMED STATEMENTS MADE BY THE 17 IMPORTERS THAT PRODUCTION DATES FOR ALL TIRES SHIPPED TO IMPORTERS OTHER THAN FTS BEGAN AFTER THE FORTH WEEK OF 2006, AND ARE THEREFORE PHASE III TIRES AND DIFFERENT FROM THE TIRES RECALLED BY FTS.NO INFORMATION WAS FOUND TO VERIFY THE JUNE 11TH FTS IMPLICATION THAT OTHER IMPORTERS BROUGHT TIRES SIMILAR TO THE RECALLED TIRES INTO THE US MARKET.THIS INVESTIGATION HAS FOUND NO INFORMATION SHOWING THAT ANY IMPORTERS OTHER THAN FTS IMPORTED TIRES SUBSTANTIALLY SIMILAR TO THE PHASE II RECALLED TIRES.ALL DEFECTIVE PHASE II TIRES, MANUFACTURED BY HZR AND IMPORTED INTO THE US MARKET (APPROXIMATELY 270,014 TIRES), ARE BEING RECALLED THROUGH CAMPAIGN 07T-003.ACCORDINGLY, NO FURTHER ACTION IS NECESSARY AND THIS INVESTIGATION IS CLOSED.

subject: FREIGHTLINER CHASSIS/SAF-HOLLAND EQUIP.
summary: ON APRIL 4, 2008, SAF-HOLLAND REPORTED THAT CERTAIN ADL & ADLSD TRANSVERSE BEAM ASSEMBLIES, PRODUCED BETWEEN JULY 1, 2007 AND OCTOBER 10, 2007, MIGHT HAVE BEEN INCORRECTLY WELDED DURING PRODUCTION.SHOULD A TRANSVERSE BEAM ASSEMBLY FAIL DURING VEHICLE OPERATION, LOSS OF VEHICLE CONTROL LEADING TO A CRASH IS POSSIBLE.SHOULD A TRANSVERSE BEAM ASSEMBLY FALL TO THE GROUND DURING VEHICLE OPERATION, SPARKS MAY OCCUR POSING A FIRE HAZARD. AS ALL OTHER CUSTOMERS OF SAF-HOLLAND HAD SUBMITTED INFORMATION TO NHTSA, ONLY 8 OF FREIGHTLINER'S CUSTOMERS WERE INCLUDED IN THIS EQ.WITH FREIGHTLINER CONDUCTING THE RECALL CAMPAIGN, RMD REQUESTED MAKE/MODEL INFORMATION FROM THEIR 8 CUSTOMERS OR, IF THEY CHOSE, SUBMISSION OF A DEFECT REPORT FOR VEHICLES THAT RECEIVED THESE CHASSIS.RMD MAILED THESE 8 VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS IR LETTERS ON 11/6/2008.RESPONSES WERE RECEIVED FROM ALL BUT ALFA LEISURE INC. WHO IS NO LONGER OPERATING.3 MANUFACTURERS DID NOT NEED TO SUBMIT MAKE/MODEL INFORMATION OR DEFECT REPORTS TO NHTSA AS THEY EITHER DID NOT RETAIL ANY RECALLED UNITS OR THEY WERE ONLY RETAILED OUTSIDE THE U.S.4 MANUFACTURERS, CRAFTSMEN LIMO, FARBER SPECIALTY VEHICLES, FLEETWOOD, AND TIFFIN MOTOR HOMES ALL CHOSE TO SUBMIT MAKE/MODEL INFORMATION TO RMD IN LIEU OF DEFECT REPORTS FOR THEIR AFFECTED VEHICLES.ALL MAKE/MODELS OF AFFECTED VEHICLES HAVE BEEN ADDED TO FREIGHTLINER RECALL# 08V-269.IR RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: Irvine Shade & Door Glass Shower Doors
summary: On September 6, 2007 Keystone RV Company notified NHTSA (07V-411) that certain Irvine Shade & Door glass shower doors with towel bars could break if pressure is applied to the towel bar.The risk of glass breakage can result in personal injury.Keystone stated that vehicles produced between October 19, 2006 and July 26, 2007 were affected.On December 4, 2008 Coachmen RV notified NHTSA (08V-639) that Coachmen vehicles produced between June 15, 2001 and August 6, 2007 also contained this equipment.On 12/30/2008, RMD mailed Irvine an IR letter requesting its customer list and determination on whether an equipment Defect Report would be filed with NHTSA.After no response, another IR letter was mailed to Irvine on 3/5/2009.Irvine submitted a customer list to NHTSA's Chief Counsel on 6/4/2009 requesting confidentiality for its customer list.However, no letter was submitted answering RMD's questions on whether a Defect Report would be filed.On 11/13/2009, Chief Counsel granted confidentiality to Irvine's customer list while allowing limited release of OEM names for needed RMD mailings.On 12/23/2009, RMD mailed IR letters to 161 companies identified as vehicle manufacturers & new vehicle alterers (out of 502 customers on Irvine's customer list).IR response statistics below: IR letters mailed: 161 IR Responses :72 No response :63 Returned letters:26Of those responding to RMD's IR letter, 75% (54 of 72 companies) stated they had never purchased the subject glass shower doors from Irvine.Irvine supplied many of these companies with a letter stating that the inclusion of their company name on the customer list submitted to NHTSA was done in error.No revised or corrected customer list was ever submitted to RMD.Those companies that did purchase the subject shower doors chose not to file any subsequent Defect Reports citing ongoing reviews of warranty claims or no substantial warranty history at all.On 3/22/2010, another IR letter was mailed to Irvine requesting a corrected customer list and defect determination.No response was ever received.Preliminary referral to NHTSA Chief Counsel indicates this matter will not be addressed immediately due to current workload.Future referral to NCC for civil penalties is likely considering Irvine's inability to respond to several NHTSA information requests under 49 USC 30166.This EQ is closed.

subject: SUBURBAN GLASS TOP COOKTOPS
summary: ON JULY 13, 2007, SUBURBAN MANUFACTURING COMPANY (SUBURBAN) NOTIFIED NHTSA THAT CERTAIN GLASS TOP SEALED BURNER RANGES AND COOK TOPS CONTAIN A BURNER TUBE CONNECTOR THAT MAY HAVE NOT BEEN FULLY TIGHTENED.SHOULD A BURNER TUBE RELEASE A CONCENTRATED AMOUNT OF NATURAL GAS AND AN IGNITION SOURCE IS PRESENT, A FIRE MAY OCCUR.SUBURBAN STATED THESE UNITS WERE PRODUCED BETWEEN AUGUST 22, 2006 AND NOVEMBER 22, 2006. ON JANUARY 29, 2009 RMD MAILED THE 8 REMAINING VEHICLE MANUFACTURERS TO ASK HOW THIS EQUIPMENT WAS SOLD.GULF STREAM COACH FILED A DEFECT REPORT (09V-135) FOR THEIR UNITS THAT WERE USED IN NEW MOTOR VEHICLES.4 COMPANIES RESPONDED THAT THEIR UNITS WERE EITHER FOR PERSONAL VEHICLES OR NEVER INSTALLED INTO NEW MOTOR VEHICLES.A COMPANY LISTED AS SMC SLS SAMPLE COMPRISED OF 7 SAMPLE UNITS ONLY.A TOTAL OF 3 COMPANIES (REPRESENTING A TOTAL OF 5 RECALLED COOKTOPS) WERE UNREACHABLE AND COULD NOT BE CONTACTED BY PHONE OR EMAIL EITHER. EQ RESPONSES CAN BE FOUND BELOW OR IN THE DOCUMENT REPOSITORY.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

subject: LONG CHIH TRAILERS MISSING TIRE PLACARDS
summary: ON MARCH 11, 2009, LONG CHIH INDUSTRIAL COMPANY LIMITED (LONG CHIH), LOCATED IN TAIWAN, NOTIFIED NHTSA THAT CERTAIN TRAILERS THAT HAD BEEN IMPORTED INTO THE U.S., MANUFACTURED BETWEEN 9/1/2005 AND 12/31/2008, FAIL TO COMPLY WITH FEDERAL MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY STANDARD (FMVSS) 110 IN THAT THEY DO NOT DISPLAY A TIRE PLACARD LABEL STATING THE REQUIRED TIRE SIZE, TIRE PRESSURE, AND MAXIMUM LOAD CAPACITY OF THE TRAILER.LONG CHIH, INDICATED THAT IT WOULD CONDUCT THIS RECALL, NOTIFY ALL U.S. CUSTOMERS AND PROVIDE THE REQUIRED LABEL FOR OWNERS TO APPLY TO THE TRAILER, ALONG WITH AN INFORMATION SHEET. ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.

ON 4/23/2009 IR LETTERS WERE WRITTEN TO 7 COMPANIES LONG CHIH IDENTIFIED AS U.S. IMPORTERS OF THESE TRAILERS.6 OF THE 7 COMPANIES PROMPTLY FILED NONCOMPLIANCE REPORTS WITH THIS OFFICE AND PROVIDED CUSTOMER INFORMATION TO LONG CHIH SO CUSTOMER NOTIFICATIONS COULD BE MAILED.ONE COMPANY, HASKELL CORP., STATED THEY NEVER PURCHASED OR IMPORTED THESE TRAILERS.AN ADDITIONAL COMPANY, STATE TRAILER SUPPLY, WAS IDENTIFIED IN CUSTOMS RECORDS NHTSA OBTAINED AS IMPORTING 100 OF THESE TRAILERS.INFORMATION REQUEST LETTERS WERE MAILED TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY ON 4/23/2009 AND 7/21/2009, AND BOTH WERE UNANSWERED.AFTER PHONE CALLS, EMAILS, AND A FAX TO STATE TRAILER SUPPLY WITH THE INFORMATION THEY WOULD NEED TO FILE A NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT, STILL NO RESPONSE OR NONCOMPLIANCE REPORT WAS FILED.STATE TRAILER SUPPLY'S FAILURE TO REPLY TO THE IR LETTERS WILL BE REFERRED TO THE OFFICE OF THE CHIEF COUNCIL FOR FURTHER ACTION.THIS EQ IS CLOSED.
